items.name: menu-brunch-list
items.title: Menu Brunch List
items.description: A brunch menu laid out as an open two-page book on cream paper, with line icons, dotted price leaders and a sticky ribbon that totals the dishes you tap and places the order.

items.name: menu-qr-table
items.title: Menu QR Table
items.description: A dine-in QR menu shown inside a phone, next to a scannable-looking table code with a sweeping scan line. Guests filter by category, add dishes and send the order to the kitchen.

items.name: menu-drinks-cafe
items.title: Menu Drinks Cafe
items.description: A pastel cafe drink list with a drink builder: hot or iced re-tints the illustrated cup, size chips change the price and scale the cup, and milk and extras add to a live total.

items.name: menu-tasting-courses
items.title: Menu Tasting Courses
items.description: A dark fine-dining tasting menu with numbered courses on a drawn gold line, wine pairings that light up when the pairing switch is on, and a per-person total with a guest stepper.

items.name: menu-delivery-order
items.title: Menu Delivery Order
items.description: A delivery ordering page with a searchable menu, category tabs and a cart panel with quantity steppers, a free delivery meter, tip chips, a live total and a checkout confirmation.

items.name: menu-burger-board
items.title: Menu Burger Board
items.description: A loud street-food burger menu with a category rail, illustrated item cards, quantity steppers and a floating order bar whose total bumps on every add, ending in an order confirmation.

items.name: menu-pizza-sizes
items.title: Menu Pizza Sizes
items.description: A warm paper pizzeria menu where a size toggle and a crust select reprice every pizza live, while a spinning illustrated pizza grows with the chosen size.

items.name: menu-chalkboard
items.title: Menu Chalkboard
items.description: A framed bistro chalkboard with letter-spaced chalk headings, dotted price leaders in two columns and a dashed Today's special box with a slow chalk shimmer.

items.name: menu-combo-builder
items.title: Menu Combo Builder
items.description: A neon combo builder: pick a main, side, drink and size through a stepper while a receipt ticket counts up the combo price and shows the savings against buying each piece alone.

items.name: map-route-replay
items.title: Map Route Replay
items.description: A procedural isometric city on canvas where a run replays as a glowing runner with a fading trail and kilometre markers. A time-of-day slider moves the sun, its shadows and the sky tint.

items.name: map-city-blocks
items.title: Map City Blocks
items.description: An extruded procedural city on canvas that slowly turns on its own, rotates with drag and inertia, and switches to a night view with lit windows and street lamps.

items.name: map-pin-board
items.title: Map Pin Board
items.description: A flat stylized map with pulsing pins. Hovering or focusing a pin raises a floating card with its details; arrow keys move between pins.

items.name: map-store-locator
items.title: Map Store Locator
items.description: A location list beside a stylized map. Choosing a store pans and zooms the map to its pin, and clicking a pin selects the store. Stacks into a map with a swipeable card row below 520px.

items.name: map-heat-dots
items.title: Map Heat Dots
items.description: A dot-density heat map over a coastal city silhouette with a slow shimmer. Hovering or moving with the arrow keys reads the value and district of a dot.

items.name: map-route-stats
items.title: Map Route Stats
items.description: An activity card with a route outline, four stats and an elevation and pace profile. Hovering or scrubbing the profile moves a dot along the route in sync.

items.name: carousel-ring-3d
items.title: Carousel Ring 3D
items.description: Cards standing on a circular orbit in real CSS perspective. Drag or swipe with inertia and snap, use the arrow keys or the buttons, or let it autoplay.

items.name: hud-frame
items.title: HUD Frame
items.description: A panel with corner brackets, a monospace header with a status chip and an optional scanning line over its content.

items.name: hud-boot-screen
items.title: HUD Boot Screen
items.description: A boot sequence with a logo, a segmented progress bar and status rows that resolve one by one from WAIT to READY. Click to replay.

items.name: hud-shelf-slider
items.title: HUD Shelf Slider
items.description: A stepped horizontal slider with tick marks, a diamond thumb, a 03 / 09 counter and the name of the current step.

items.name: hud-filter-chips
items.title: HUD Filter Chips
items.description: A row of bracket-cornered filter chips with single or multiple selection, an All option and arrow key navigation.

items.name: hud-status-bar
items.title: HUD Status Bar
items.description: A bottom bar with a key label, meta values split by hairlines and keyboard hints. Values tick up when they change.

items.name: hud-detail-panel
items.title: HUD Detail Panel
items.description: A framed detail card with a kicker, a large title, a short description, a meta grid and a row of bracket buttons.

items.name: hud-search-field
items.title: HUD Search Field
items.description: A search input with a slash shortcut that focuses it from anywhere, a clear button, bracket corners that open on focus and a results readout.

items.name: hud-orbit-backdrop
items.title: HUD Orbit Backdrop
items.description: A decorative backdrop of dotted orbits seen in perspective over a faint grid, with small nodes travelling along the rings. Pure CSS.

items.name: hud-toggle-switch
items.title: HUD Toggle Switch
items.description: A compact labelled switch like SND ON with bracket corners, a status dot and a flash on every click.

items.name: local-booking-card
items.title: Local Booking Card
items.description: A clinic hero with an appointment card beside it: pick a service, a date chip and a time slot, then confirm to see a booking ticket.

items.name: local-menu-board
items.title: Local Menu Board
items.description: A restaurant menu with tabs for each course, dotted price leaders and a featured dish card with an illustrated plate.

items.name: local-hours-map
items.title: Local Hours and Map
items.description: Opening hours with today highlighted and an Open now badge, next to an illustrated street map with a dropping pin and a Get directions button.

items.name: local-team-grid
items.title: Local Team Grid
items.description: Practitioner cards with illustrated portraits, years of experience, specialty chips and a booking link that lift on hover.

items.name: local-services-price-list
items.title: Local Services Price List
items.description: Services in columns with duration and price, a shimmering popular marker and a bold package offer underneath.

items.name: local-reservation-bar
items.title: Local Reservation Bar
items.description: A wide reservation bar with date, time and a guest stepper over a warm sunset street scene, with live availability dots around the chosen time.

items.name: local-before-after
items.title: Local Before and After
items.description: A draggable, keyboard accessible before and after slider with two illustrated kitchen scenes, caption chips and a strip of project results.

items.name: local-reviews-wall
items.title: Local Reviews Wall
items.description: A rating summary with a star distribution beside two columns of review cards that drift slowly in opposite directions and pause on hover.

items.name: comparison-tiers
items.title: Comparison Tiers
items.description: Plan cards side by side that list the same feature rows, so checks, dashes and values line up across tiers. The recommended plan gets a rotating beam border and a badge, and hovering a row highlights it in every card.

items.name: comparison-scorecard
items.title: Comparison Scorecard
items.description: An us versus them scorecard with two overall score rings and a list of benchmark metrics, each with paired bars that grow in and numbers that count up, plus a delta chip per row.

items.name: comparison-calculator
items.title: Comparison Calculator
items.description: A light pricing calculator where sliders for seats and contacts and a monthly or yearly switch update a bar chart of your price against competitors, with the yearly savings counting to the new value.

items.name: nav-tab-bar
items.title: Nav Tab Bar
items.description: A mobile bottom tab bar with a glowing blob that springs and squashes to the active tab, count and dot badges, and arrow key support. The preview shows it inside a phone whose screens slide with the selection.

items.name: nav-app-header
items.title: Nav App Header
items.description: A light app header with a workspace breadcrumb and live status, a search button with a Cmd K shortcut, notifications and an account menu, over a row of tabs with counts and a sliding underline.

items.name: nav-side-dock
items.title: Nav Side Dock
items.description: A vertical icon dock pinned to the side of an app. Icons swell as the pointer passes over them, a slow wave runs through the dock while idle, and tooltips, badges and an active indicator sit beside each icon.

items.name: showcase-bento-gallery
items.title: Showcase Bento Gallery
items.description: A bento grid of product screens that reveal with a staggered wipe. On hover or focus each screenshot zooms and a caption slides up with a short description and an arrow.

items.name: showcase-before-after
items.title: Showcase Before After
items.description: A light redesign showcase: a browser frame holds the old and new screen, split by a draggable divider that also works with arrow keys. It sweeps once on load to hint that it moves, with result stats underneath.

items.name: showcase-device-tabs
items.title: Showcase Device Tabs
items.description: A feature carousel with a list of tabs beside a large laptop. Each tab swaps the screen with a staggered build, and a progress line advances the tour on its own, pausing on hover or focus.

items.name: download-changelog
items.title: Download Changelog
items.description: A release section with the latest version card, highlights and download buttons per platform, next to a changelog timeline that draws in, with collapsible releases, typed notes and filters for new, improved and fixed.

items.name: download-requirements
items.title: Download Requirements
items.description: A light system requirements block with macOS, Windows and Linux tabs on a sliding pill. Each tab shows a minimum versus recommended table with meters, plus the installer, its checksum with copy, and other formats.

items.name: download-qr-handoff
items.title: Download QR Handoff
items.description: A continue on your phone card with a QR pattern built from the link, a scan line sweeping over it and a countdown that refreshes the code. A text me a link form and a phone preview of the session sit alongside.

items.name: contact-booking-calendar
items.title: Contact Booking Calendar
items.description: A light booking section: host card, a month calendar with open days, time slots that cascade in, then a validated details form with loading and confirmation states.

items.name: contact-chat-widget
items.title: Contact Chat Widget
items.description: A dark contact section with a support chat card: the greeting types in, quick replies stream an answer, and an inline email card validates, loads and confirms.

items.name: footer-newsletter-first
items.title: Footer Newsletter First
items.description: A paper toned footer led by a large newsletter signup with a light beam circling the email field, followed by a five column sitemap and a status bar.

items.name: footer-app-download
items.title: Footer App Download
items.description: An app footer with a promo card, generic platform download badges, a drawn QR code, a floating phone with a scrolling feed, link columns, a language select and a theme switch that recolors the footer.

items.name: cta-rotating-band
items.title: CTA Rotating Band
items.description: A full width band over a drifting gradient mesh with grain, a headline whose middle word rotates with a blur slide and an underline timer, and two buttons.

items.name: cta-sticky-dock
items.title: CTA Sticky Dock
items.description: A glass dock bar that springs up and sticks to the bottom of a framed page, shrinks while you scroll down, expands on the way up, and can be dismissed and restored.

items.name: faq-chat-thread
items.title: FAQ Chat Thread
items.description: FAQ as a conversation: questions become visitor bubbles and the answers type out with a cursor. A numbered question list sits beside the thread, chips replace it on narrow containers.

items.name: faq-flip-cards
items.title: FAQ Flip Cards
items.description: A white grid of question cards that flip in 3D to reveal the answer, with a reveal all toggle, an open counter and a hint wobble on the first card.

items.name: pricing-seats-slider
items.title: Pricing Seats Slider
items.description: Per seat pricing on paper: a team size slider with a filling crowd of dots, volume bands, and three plans whose totals roll digit by digit with a per seat breakdown.

items.name: pricing-feature-table
items.title: Pricing Feature Table
items.description: A dark comparison table with a sticky blurred header of plans and prices, collapsible feature groups, a monthly or yearly switch that flips the prices, and plan tabs on narrow containers.

items.name: stats-mosaic
items.title: Stats Mosaic
items.description: A by the numbers bento: counting figures in tiles that each carry a different animated mini visual, from a drawing area chart and uptime bars to a dot field, gauge, avatar marquee and star fill.

items.name: stats-before-after
items.title: Stats Before After
items.description: A light case study block that plays numbers from before to after, with a draggable timeline, Before and After buttons, delta pills whose arrows flip, comparison bars and a customer quote.

items.name: dashboard-crypto
items.title: Crypto Portfolio Dashboard
items.description: A portfolio screen with a scrolling price ticker, total balance with a sparkline, an allocation donut, a candlestick chart with volume and range tabs, recent activity and a sortable holdings table. Selecting an asset charts it.

items.name: dashboard-hr
items.title: HR People Dashboard
items.description: A light people operations screen on warm paper: headcount by team as stacked columns, a hiring pipeline funnel, a November time-off heatmap with day details, upcoming reviews and a team directory, all filtered by team.

items.name: dashboard-support
items.title: Customer Support Dashboard
items.description: A help desk overview with segmented KPI meters, ticket volume by hour against last week and a forecast, an SLA gauge with a target marker, a queue with priority pills, assignees and SLA countdowns, a CSAT trend and a live activity feed.

items.name: dashboard-marketing
items.title: Marketing Campaigns Dashboard
items.description: A campaign report with a KPI band, a sortable channel table with inline spend and ROAS bars, a flowing conversion funnel, budget burn rings with pacing, top regions and gradient creative thumbnails ranked by CTR.

items.name: notfound-maze
items.title: 404 Maze
items.description: A dark 404 section where a tiny pixel explorer wanders a grid maze looking for the exit. Point anywhere on the grid, or use the arrow keys, and it finds a path toward you.

items.name: notfound-letter
items.title: 404 Apology Letter
items.description: A light 404 page written as a typed letter on airmail paper. The apology types itself out, then a red 404 return to sender stamp thumps onto the sheet.

items.name: proof-case-studies
items.title: Case Study Cards
items.description: Three case study cards with a wordmark, an industry tag and one big result that counts up on scroll. Hovering a card lifts the number and slides the customer quote up from below.

items.name: proof-live-activity
items.title: Live Activity Proof
items.description: A light social proof section pairing a rating summary with a live feed of recent sign ups. New activity toasts slide in at the top every few seconds while older ones drift down and fade.

items.name: how-stepper-screens
items.title: Stepper With Screens
items.description: A how it works section with a vertical stepper beside a mock app window. Each step swaps the screen with a blur and slide, and the steps advance on their own with a progress bar.

items.name: how-dashed-path
items.title: Dashed Path Steps
items.description: Four numbered cards on paper, joined by a marching dashed route. A dot travels the path and each card lights up as the dot reaches it; on narrow screens the route turns vertical.

items.name: blog-newsletter-issues
items.title: Newsletter Issue List
items.description: A newsletter archive section: numbered issues with date, topics and reading time that reveal an excerpt on hover, beside a subscribe card with a rotating border and email validation.

items.name: blog-category-tiles
items.title: Blog Category Tiles
items.description: A light blog index with six topic tiles, each with its own color, floating shape and post count, followed by a dark featured post strip with a zooming cover.

items.name: shop-reviews
items.title: Product Reviews
items.description: A light product reviews section with an average score, a clickable rating histogram, a recommend ring, filter chips and review cards with verified badges and helpful votes.

items.name: shop-category-mosaic
items.title: Category Mosaic
items.description: A mosaic of shop categories with gradient scenes and product silhouettes. Tiles wipe in on scroll and zoom their image on hover while an arrow and tagline slide in.

items.name: shop-order-tracking
items.title: Order Tracking
items.description: An order status section with a stylized city map where a courier van drives the route to a pulsing pin, an ETA card, a delivery timeline and the items in the parcel.

items.name: app-settings-page
items.title: App Settings Page
items.description: An account settings screen with vertical tabs for profile, notifications, security and billing. A save bar slides up as soon as anything changes.

items.name: app-notifications-center
items.title: App Notifications Center
items.description: A full notifications inbox with All, Mentions and Unread filters, day groups, mark as read, a snooze menu with undo, an empty state and a detail pane.

items.name: app-calendar-month
items.title: App Calendar Month
items.description: A month calendar with colored event chips, a highlighted today, an event popover, sliding month changes and an agenda panel for the selected day.

items.name: app-file-manager
items.title: App File Manager
items.description: A file browser with breadcrumbs, grid and list views, checkbox selection with a bulk action bar, a storage meter and a drag-over upload overlay.

items.name: app-chat-inbox
items.title: App Chat Inbox
items.description: A team chat screen with channels and direct messages, grouped bubbles with day dividers, a composer with attachment chips and a live typing indicator.

items.name: app-profile-editor
items.title: App Profile Editor
items.description: A portfolio profile editor with a live preview card beside the form, a photo upload, link rows you can add and remove, skill chips and a card color picker.

items.name: app-onboarding-checklist
items.title: App Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A light getting-started screen with a progress ring, expandable checklist steps, a confetti burst when everything is done, plus Skip for now and dismiss.

items.name: sidebar-mail-folders
items.title: Sidebar Mail Folders
items.description: A mail app sidebar with a compose button, folders with unread counts, colored labels and a storage meter that fills on mount.

items.name: sidebar-chat-channels
items.title: Sidebar Chat Channels
items.description: A team chat sidebar with channels and direct messages in two collapsible sections, presence dots and bold unread rows.

items.name: sidebar-icon-labels
items.title: Sidebar Icon Labels
items.description: A narrow icon rail that expands on hover or focus into a labeled sidebar floating over the content, with a sliding active indicator.

items.name: sidebar-sections-accordion
items.title: Sidebar Sections Accordion
items.description: Grouped sidebar sections that expand with animated height, stagger their items in and can remember which ones were open.

items.name: sidebar-settings-nav
items.title: Sidebar Settings Nav
items.description: A settings sidebar with a back link, grouped items and a search field that filters items live and highlights the match.

items.name: list-timeline-vertical
items.title: List Timeline Vertical
items.description: A vertical timeline of events with icon nodes, a connecting line that draws in, relative timestamps and expandable details.

items.name: list-notifications-grouped
items.title: List Notifications Grouped
items.description: Notifications grouped by day with unread dots, a mark all as read button and hover actions to toggle read or dismiss a row.

items.name: list-pinned-reorder
items.title: List Pinned Reorder
items.description: A list where items pin to the top and move up or down with buttons or Alt and arrow keys, animated with a FLIP transition.

items.name: list-expandable-rows
items.title: List Expandable Rows
items.description: Rows that open in place to reveal details with a smooth height transition, one at a time or several at once.

items.name: agent-trace-timeline
items.title: Agent Trace Timeline
items.description: A vertical trace of an agent run. Each span shows a status icon, a nested name and a bar sized to its start and duration, and spans with a payload expand in place.

items.name: agent-approval-card
items.title: Agent Approval Card
items.description: A human-in-the-loop card for a proposed agent action, with a before and after summary, an Approve step that asks for confirmation, inline editing and a countdown that rejects on its own.

items.name: agent-memory-panel
items.title: Agent Memory Panel
items.description: A list of facts the agent remembers, each with a source chip and a confidence meter. Facts can be edited in place or forgotten with an animated removal.

items.name: agent-model-picker
items.title: Agent Model Picker
items.description: A model selector with capability tags and speed and cost meters. It follows the listbox pattern with arrow keys, Home, End, typeahead and Escape.

items.name: agent-file-diff
items.title: Agent File Diff
items.description: A compact unified diff viewer with line numbers, hunk headers, added and removed lines, collapsible unchanged context and a button that copies the patch.

items.name: agent-composer-attachments
items.title: Agent Composer with Attachments
items.description: A message composer with animated attachment chips, a slash-command menu that opens on "/" and a send button with idle, ready, sending and sent states.

items.name: site-toc-scrollspy
items.title: Table of Contents Scrollspy
items.description: A sticky table of contents whose active item follows the page as you scroll, marked by an indicator that slides between entries. Clicking an entry scrolls to its section.

items.name: site-promo-modal
items.title: Promo Modal
items.description: A promotional popup with a gradient artwork side, a delayed entrance and a don't-show-again checkbox. It closes with Escape or a click on the backdrop, and renders inside its own relative frame.

items.name: site-hotspot-tour
items.title: Hotspot Tour
items.description: A product tour made of pulsing hotspots laid over a mock interface, with a step popover that offers Next, Back and Skip and works with the arrow keys.

items.name: site-announcement-ticker
items.title: Announcement Ticker
items.description: A thin announcement bar that rotates several messages vertically, with a progress hairline, a counter, pause on hover and focus, and a dismiss button.

items.name: about-team-filter
items.title: About Team Filter
items.description: A team grid with filter chips per team. Hovering or focusing a card lifts the avatar and slides up a bio panel with location, and cards stagger back in whenever the filter changes.

items.name: about-timeline-scroll
items.title: About Timeline Scroll
items.description: A light, horizontal company timeline with snap scrolling. A year rail above fills as you scroll, the active year lights up, and arrow buttons, year markers and the keyboard all move between milestones.

items.name: about-mission-split
items.title: About Mission Split
items.description: A huge mission statement on the left that reveals word by word with highlighted words, and three numbered principle cards on the right whose metrics count up when they scroll into view.

items.name: about-press-wall
items.title: About Press Wall
items.description: A white press section with two marquee rows of typographic wordmark chips moving in opposite directions, a rotating serif press quote with progress dots, a row of award cards with laurels and a press kit link.

items.name: waitlist-inline-pill
items.title: Waitlist Inline Pill
items.description: A minimal dark waitlist with one inline email field over a breathing halo. Invalid input shakes the field, the button shows a spinner while saving, and the form morphs into a success pill with a drawn check.

items.name: waitlist-referral-board
items.title: Waitlist Referral Board
items.description: A referral waitlist with a name and email form, reward tiers and a live leaderboard of top referrers with animated bars. After joining, your spot counts up, a referral link appears with a copy button and you join the board.

items.name: waitlist-teaser-unlock
items.title: Waitlist Teaser Unlock
items.description: A light split waitlist with a blurred product preview behind a lock badge and a scanning shimmer. Joining with email and team size sharpens the preview into focus and swaps the form for a confirmation.

items.name: waitlist-capacity-countdown
items.title: Waitlist Capacity Countdown
items.description: A dark launch panel with a rolling four-unit countdown, a striped capacity bar that fills toward the seat limit, a spots-left counter that ticks as people join and an email form that reserves a numbered seat.

items.name: profile-settings-card
items.title: Profile Settings Card
items.description: A light settings page with a section nav and a profile card: avatar color swatches tint the cover, fields validate inline, edited fields get a dot, and a footer tracks unsaved changes with reset, saving and saved states.

items.name: profile-team-presence
items.title: Profile Team Presence
items.description: A grid of teammate cards with presence dots that pulse when online, status notes, a typing indicator, local times and message and call actions, filtered by a status switch and a search field.

items.name: profile-resume-timeline
items.title: Profile Resume Timeline
items.description: A resume profile with a sticky card holding the person, availability, summary and animated skill bars, beside an experience timeline whose line draws down and whose current role pulses, plus education.

items.name: loader-gears
items.title: Loader Gears
items.description: Three toothed gears mesh and turn in opposite directions, each at the right speed for its tooth count.

items.name: loader-hourglass
items.title: Loader Hourglass
items.description: An hourglass whose sand drains through the neck, then flips over and refills for the next round.

items.name: loader-dna-helix
items.title: Loader DNA Helix
items.description: A double helix of dots twists in sine motion, with depth shading and rungs that stretch between the strands.

items.name: loader-battery-fill
items.title: Loader Battery Fill
items.description: A battery icon fills with segments, pulses when full and starts over. Pass a value to show a fixed charge level instead.

items.name: loader-signal-bars
items.title: Loader Signal Bars
items.description: Signal bars of growing height light up one after another, like a device searching for a connection.

items.name: loader-book-flip
items.title: Loader Book Flip
items.description: An open book whose pages turn one after another in 3D, then return to the right-hand stack.

items.name: loader-bouncing-balls
items.title: Loader Bouncing Balls
items.description: Three balls of different colors bounce out of phase, squashing on impact above a soft ground shadow.

items.name: loader-rocket-trail
items.title: Loader Rocket Trail
items.description: A small rocket accelerates along a curved path and leaves a trail that fades behind it, then launches again.

items.name: button-ink-ripple
items.title: Button Ink Ripple
items.description: A button whose click ripple spreads from the exact pointer position and takes its ink color from the variant. Keyboard activation ripples from the center.

items.name: button-border-spin
items.title: Button Border Spin
items.description: A pill button with a conic gradient comet orbiting its edge around a solid inner face. The border spins all the time or only on hover.

items.name: button-icon-slide-expand
items.title: Button Icon Slide Expand
items.description: A round icon button that grows to reveal its label on hover or focus. The width animates, so neighboring items in a flex row glide aside.

items.name: button-split-halves
items.title: Button Split Halves
items.description: The label is cut in two and the halves slide apart on hover, uncovering an alternate label or icon underneath.

items.name: button-countdown-confirm
items.title: Button Countdown Confirm
items.description: A destructive button that arms on the first press, drains a countdown ring next to a Cancel button and confirms on its own at zero.

items.name: button-tilt-glare
items.title: Button Tilt Glare
items.description: A chunky 3D button that tilts toward the pointer with a moving glare and a shadow that shifts opposite the tilt. It sways on its own until touched.

items.name: button-underline-grow
items.title: Button Underline Grow
items.description: A text link or button whose underline grows from the center while an arrow nudges forward. After it is used, the text shifts to a visited color.

items.name: button-bubbles-pop
items.title: Button Bubbles Pop
items.description: A button that squashes on press, rebounds and releases a handful of bubbles that float up and pop. The scatter is deterministic.

items.name: gallery-showcase
items.title: Gallery Showcase
items.description: A large featured image above a row of thumbnails. Picking a thumbnail crossfades the feature with a slow settle, slides the caption in and restarts the autoplay progress.

items.name: gallery-archive
items.title: Gallery Archive
items.description: A typographic archive index of year, title and type. Hovering or focusing an entry dims the other rows and shows a floating image preview that trails the pointer.

items.name: gallery-backstage
items.title: Gallery Backstage
items.description: A dark stage with the images standing in a row. A soft spotlight cone picks out the active one while the rest wait dimmed behind; drag across the stage, click or use the arrows to move the light.

items.name: gallery-grid-expand
items.title: Gallery Grid Expand
items.description: A grid of image cards. Opening a card grows it from its own spot to fill the grid with the title and caption; Back or Escape shrinks it back into place.

items.name: gallery-coverflow
items.title: Gallery Coverflow
items.description: A classic cover flow: the center image faces you while the others turn away in 3D and stack to each side, with a soft reflection on the floor. Drag, click a side image or use the arrow keys.

items.name: gallery-filmstrip
items.title: Gallery Filmstrip
items.description: A strip of film with sprocket holes and edge numbers drifts under a center gate, and the frame in the gate is projected large in the viewer above.

items.name: gallery-rail-hang
items.title: Gallery Rail Hang
items.description: Prints hang from a clothes rail on small hangers and swing like pendulums when the pointer brushes past or the rail is dragged. Clicking one pulls it forward.

items.name: gallery-coverflow-lights
items.title: Gallery Coverflow Lights
items.description: A cover flow where the active image throws soft colored light onto the stage while the neighbors turn away into the dark.

items.name: gallery-scatter
items.title: Gallery Scatter
items.description: Polaroid-style prints lie scattered at loose angles. Drag any of them to the top of the pile, or tidy the whole table into a neat grid.

items.name: gallery-runway
items.title: Gallery Runway
items.description: Framed images walk toward the viewer along a lit runway in 3D, growing and stepping aside as they pass. Hovering a frame stops the flow.

items.name: carousel-lightbox
items.title: Carousel Lightbox
items.description: A thumbnail strip where each image opens in a lightbox. The picture zooms out of its thumbnail and flies back on close, with previous and next, Escape and a focus trap.

items.name: carousel-page-count
items.title: Carousel Page Count
items.description: A swipeable carousel with a rolling two-digit page counter, a progress hairline and arrow buttons that disable at both ends.

items.name: carousel-scrubber
items.title: Carousel Scrubber
items.description: A card carousel with a draggable scrubber under it. Dragging moves the track continuously and releases onto the nearest stop. Arrow keys step between stops.

items.name: card-stack-expand
items.title: Card Stack Expand
items.description: Notification cards stacked with depth. Hover, focus or the Expand button spreads them into a list, and each card dismisses with a swipe or its close button. New cards drop in from the top.

items.name: menu-context
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click and long-press menu that opens at the pointer and flips at the edges. It has icons, shortcuts, a submenu, a danger item and full keyboard control.

items.name: list-todo-animated
items.title: Animated Todo List
items.description: A task list with an add field, a check mark that draws itself, a strike-through that sweeps across the text, collapsing delete and up and down reordering that glides into place.

items.name: modal-shared-layout
items.title: Shared Layout Modal
items.description: Cards that grow into a modal and shrink back into the same spot. The card morphs by measuring its box, the content crossfades, and everything stays inside its own frame.

items.name: view-direction-switch
items.title: Direction Switch
items.description: Switches between views with tabs or steps. Moving forward slides content to the left, moving back slides it to the right, and the container height eases to the new view.

items.name: footer-reveal-under
items.title: Footer Reveal Under
items.description: A footer that sits beneath the page and is uncovered as the content above scrolls away, with a gradient wordmark that follows the pointer, link columns and a newsletter field. Wrap the page above it in FooterRevealUnderPage so it covers the footer.

items.name: scroll-image-reveal
items.title: Scroll Image Reveal
items.description: An image that opens from a thin glowing slit to full size when it scrolls into view, while it settles from a 1.3x zoom and its caption slides up line by line.

items.name: cursor-magnetic-filings
items.title: Cursor Magnetic Filings
items.description: A canvas field of iron-filing needles that swing into the field lines of a dipole magnet. A hidden magnet drifts on its own until the pointer takes over.

items.name: cursor-trail-velocity
items.title: Cursor Trail Velocity
items.description: A canvas cursor trail that reads pointer speed: slow moves leave small round dots, fast flicks stretch into long thin streaks that shift in hue.

items.name: chart-line-graph
items.title: Chart Line Graph
items.description: A responsive line graph that draws its path when it scrolls into view, with gradient area fill, gridlines, a pulsing end point and a crosshair tooltip you can drive with the pointer or the arrow keys.

items.name: hero-stagger-intro
items.title: Hero Stagger Intro
items.description: A hero section whose eyebrow, headline lines, subtitle, buttons and product visual enter one after another with a rise, blur and fade. Change the replay key to play it again.

items.name: curtain-blinds
items.title: Curtain Blinds
items.description: Venetian blind slats that tilt open one after another in 3D to reveal the content, and tilt shut in reverse order.

items.name: curtain-clip-wipe
items.title: Curtain Clip Wipe
items.description: A crisp clip-path wipe that pulls the curtain away with a bright leading edge and a soft trailing glow, in five directions.

items.name: curtain-doors
items.title: Curtain Doors
items.description: Two doors swing open from the center in 3D with shading that deepens as they turn, while the room behind brightens into view.

items.name: curtain-mixed
items.title: Curtain Mixed
items.description: A mosaic of tiles that wipe away row by row, each row in the opposite direction of the one before, in a snaking order.

items.name: curtain-iris
items.title: Curtain Iris
items.description: A scope-style iris that opens a circle from a chosen point, with a bright ring at its edge. In pointer mode a click picks the point.

items.name: curtain-stagger-wipe
items.title: Curtain Stagger Wipe
items.description: Vertical bars sweep off one after another, each trailed by a colored layer, then drop back in reverse to cover the content.

items.name: curtain-wipe
items.title: Curtain Wipe
items.description: One soft curtain that glides away with a glowing gradient edge, feathering wider as it travels across.

items.name: text-scramble-view
items.title: Text Scramble View
items.description: Text that churns through random glyphs and settles left to right when it scrolls into view. Click or press Enter to replay it.

items.name: text-scramble-center
items.title: Text Scramble Center
items.description: Scrambled text that locks in from the middle outward. Each letter flares with a soft glow the moment it resolves.

items.name: typewriter-human
items.title: Typewriter Human
items.description: A typewriter with uneven rhythm: longer beats after punctuation, the occasional wrong key noticed late and backspaced. The sequence is seeded, so it is identical on every render.

items.name: typewriter-swap
items.title: Typewriter Swap
items.description: Types a phrase, holds it, then deletes only what differs before typing the next one. A shared opening stays on screen and is dimmed while the rest is erased.

items.name: ticker-vertical
items.title: Ticker Vertical
items.description: A news ticker that scrolls upward in a loop. The row passing through the middle lights up, the edges fade out, and hover or focus pauses it. Two columns scroll in opposite directions.

items.name: loader-fill-text
items.title: Loader Fill Text
items.description: An outlined word that fills with color from the bottom up behind a rolling wave surface. Drive it with a value or let it loop.

items.name: loader-line-reveal
items.title: Loader Line Reveal
items.description: Thin lines draw across one after another, and the title and placeholder bars beneath each line wipe in behind it as loading completes.

items.name: loader-jumping-dots
items.title: Loader Jumping Dots
items.description: Three dots hop in turn, squashing when they land and stretching in the air, with a shadow on the ground that shrinks as they rise.

items.name: loader-dots-pulse
items.title: Loader Dots Pulse
items.description: Three dots swell and brighten one after another, with an optional text label in front, for inline waiting states.

items.name: hero-dot-globe
items.title: Hero Dot Globe
items.description: A pure black hero with a huge canvas sphere of thousands of tiny dots that spins on a tilted axis, leans toward the pointer and carries a bright belt drifting the other way. Sparse mono details frame a bottom-aligned headline and an install command.

items.name: hero-dot-earth
items.title: Hero Dot Earth
items.description: A pure black hero with a huge canvas planet of thousands of tiny dots where the continents stand out bright against a sparse ocean. It spins on a tilted axis, leans toward the pointer, with a bottom-aligned headline and an install command.

items.name: hero-dot-saturn
items.title: Hero Dot Saturn
items.description: A black hero with a holographic ringed planet built from thousands of square dots: banded latitudes, three rings with gaps that pass in front of and behind the sphere, the planet shadow on the rings, a scan sweep and a dotted projector base.

items.name: hero-dot-dna
items.title: Hero Dot DNA
items.description: A black hero with a holographic double helix of square dots standing on a projector base. Two strands joined by base pair rungs turn about their axis while bright pulses run along the strands and light up each rung they pass.

items.name: hero-dot-orbit
items.title: Hero Dot Orbit
items.description: A black hero with a holographic atom of square dots: a glowing nucleus of clustered spheres, faint dotted orbit rings at different tilts and bright electrons with fading trails, floating over a projector base and leaning toward the pointer.

items.name: hero-dot-galaxy
items.title: Hero Dot Galaxy
items.description: A black hero with a holographic spiral galaxy made of thousands of tiny square dots: a bright core, glowing arms that wind with inner stars moving faster, a sparse halo and a projector base below. A scan band sweeps up through it and it tilts toward the pointer.

items.name: hero-dot-torus
items.title: Hero Dot Torus
items.description: A black hero with a holographic torus or Möbius band built from square dots that keep flowing across its surface, with helical light lanes, rim light and a dotted projector base. It turns slowly on two axes and leans toward the pointer.

items.name: hero-dot-wave
items.title: Hero Dot Wave
items.description: A black hero with a perspective field of square dots rolling as layered waves toward a dark horizon. Moving or pressing the pointer sends out expanding ripples, a scan band sweeps up the field and idle ripples keep it alive.

items.name: hero-dot-text
items.title: Hero Dot Text
items.description: A black hero where any word is drawn as extruded 3D letters made of tiny dots. The word swings like a pendulum, a scan band sweeps across it from left to right, the signal flickers now and then, and the dots part around the pointer.

items.name: hero-dot-logo
items.title: Hero Dot Logo
items.description: A black hero that turns an SVG path into a hologram of extruded dots that swings like a pendulum, with a bright front face, lit side walls, an upward scan band, brief signal flicker and pointer tilt. Defaults to the Hyperblur mark.

items.name: hero-dot-silhouette
items.title: Hero Dot Silhouette
items.description: A black hero that turns an SVG or PNG into a hologram of dots: the shape comes from the alpha channel (or from dark pixels when there is none) and the depth from the image tones. It sways gently with an upward scan band. Defaults to a rocket.

items.name: hero-dot-worldmap
items.title: Hero Dot Worldmap
items.description: A full-width dot-matrix world map in the style of live traffic and threat maps: pulsing city nodes, lifted arcs with bright heads and fading trails, impact rings, a ticking stats panel and a live feed of the last five events. Hover a city to see its label and routes.

items.name: hero-dot-brain
items.title: Hero Dot Brain
items.description: A black hero with a holographic brain made of tiny dots: two hemispheres with winding folds, a cerebellum and a brain stem, seen from a three-quarter angle above a projector base. Signals crawl along the folds and synapses flash while a scan band sweeps up.

items.name: hero-dot-head
items.title: Hero Dot Head
items.description: A black hero with a stylized holographic bust drawn as horizontal dotted contour lines: skull, brow, nose, lips, ears, dim eye hollows, neck and shoulders on a projector base. It turns its head slowly while a scan line sweeps down and makes the face features flare.

items.name: hero-dot-hand
items.title: Hero Dot Hand
items.description: A black hero with an open holographic hand of tiny dots, palm toward the viewer with a slight three-quarter turn, standing on a projector base with a dotted wrist cuff. The fingers roll in a slow wave and curl a little when the pointer moves toward the bottom of the hero.

items.name: button-marquee
items.title: Button Marquee
items.description: On hover the label slides away and a looping ticker of the same words runs through a soft edge fade. A diagonal arrow chip swaps for a fresh arrow at the same moment.

items.name: button-elastic-stretch
items.title: Button Elastic Stretch
items.description: A glossy gummy button you can grab and pull: the body stretches toward the pointer with rubber-band resistance and wobbles back on a spring when released. It also leans slightly toward the cursor on hover.

items.name: button-goo
items.title: Button Goo
items.description: Droplets bud off the pill on hover and stay attached through a liquid goo filter, while a blob bulges out on the side nearest the cursor. A click splashes them outward before they flow back.

items.name: button-equalizer
items.title: Button Equalizer
items.description: A play preview button whose waveform bars come alive while playing, with an elapsed timer and a progress hairline along the bottom. The play icon spins into pause and the bars already played stay lit.

items.name: button-orbit
items.title: Button Orbit
items.description: Glowing particles circle the button on two tilted orbits, passing in front of and behind the face with real depth. Hovering spins them up, and a click flings them outward before they settle back.

items.name: button-aurora
items.title: Button Aurora
items.description: A frosted glass button floating on a slowly drifting aurora of three colors, with a matching gradient rim that flows around the edge. Hover lets the light swell out from underneath.

items.name: button-wave-letters
items.title: Button Wave Letters
items.description: While hovered, a wave rolls through the label letter by letter, lifting each glyph and tinting it at the crest. A hand-drawn squiggle draws itself underneath and keeps flowing.

items.name: button-share-expand
items.title: Button Share Expand
items.description: A Share pill that unfolds sideways into a row of action buttons, each springing in with a tooltip while the icon turns into a close cross. Actions confirm with a check and Escape folds it back.

items.name: button-parallax-layers
items.title: Button Parallax Layers
items.description: A magnetic download button built from stacked layers: the plate, the text and the icon chip each follow the pointer by a different amount, and the shadow shifts the other way. It snaps home with a soft overshoot when the pointer leaves.

items.name: button-dot-matrix
items.title: Button Dot Matrix
items.description: A terminal style button printed on a dot grid: a scan beam sweeps it while idle, dots light up in a halo around the cursor, and a click sends a bright ring of dots rippling out from the pointer.

items.name: button-odometer
items.title: Button Odometer
items.description: An upvote button whose count rolls digit by digit like a mechanical odometer, starting from the ones and settling with a small overshoot. Voting fires the arrow through the top of its tile and floats a +1.

items.name: button-trace
items.title: Button Trace
items.description: A blueprint style button whose outline is drawn around its perimeter on hover, led by a bright comet that keeps circling afterwards. Corner ticks spring outward and a click flashes the face.

items.name: button-swipe-confirm
items.title: Button Swipe Confirm
items.description: A slide-to-pay track: drag the knob with rubber-band resistance at both ends, and past the threshold it locks, spins and draws a check. Short drags spring back with an overshoot.

items.name: button-hold-ring
items.title: Button Hold Ring
items.description: A round hold-to-fire button with a tick-marked progress ring that winds up while held and unwinds faster when released early. The button rumbles harder as it charges and bursts into a check when it fires.

items.name: button-spring-press
items.title: Button Spring Press
items.description: A keycap button driven by a real spring: it squashes into its base while pressed, sinks deeper the longer you hold, and rebounds past rest with a wobble on release. Works with pointer, Space and Enter.

items.name: button-submit-morph
items.title: Button Submit Morph
items.description: A submit button that collapses into a circle with an orbiting spinner, then expands into a green success pill or a red error pill that shakes. It follows the promise returned by onSubmit.

items.name: button-dots-morph
items.title: Button Dots Morph
items.description: The letters of the label fold inward and become three hopping dots while the action runs. The dots then pinch together and the done label rises in letter by letter behind a drawn check.

items.name: button-toggle-count
items.title: Button Toggle Count
items.description: A pill toggle for like, save, bookmark or star. The icon fills from the bottom with a spring pop and sparks, and the count rolls digit by digit like an odometer.

items.name: button-split-menu
items.title: Button Split Menu
items.description: A split button whose chevron opens a menu of alternative actions; choosing one swaps the primary label with a rolling transition. Full keyboard support with arrows, Home, End and Escape.

items.name: button-speed-dial
items.title: Button Speed Dial
items.description: A floating action button that fans its actions out on an arc or stacks them upward, with a staggered spring, a dimming halo and labels. The plus turns into a close mark.

items.name: button-icon-badge
items.title: Button Icon Badge
items.description: An icon button with a notification badge cut out of the background. New items make the bell swing, the badge pop and a ring ping, and the number rolls in; clicking clears it with a drop.

items.name: button-toolbar-group
items.title: Button Toolbar Group
items.description: A floating tool palette with a springy active pill, a hover highlight that glides between tools and tooltips with shortcut keys. Arrow keys move focus and single-letter shortcuts switch tools.

items.name: button-magnetic-pill
items.title: Button Magnetic Pill
items.description: A pill that is pulled toward the cursor before you reach it: the body stretches like liquid along the pointer direction, the label trails with parallax and a highlight sits on the near side. It snaps back with an elastic overshoot.

items.name: button-press-radial
items.title: Button Press Radial
items.description: Tap to run the main action, or long-press to open a radial menu around the button and drag toward an option to pick it on release. A ring fills during the hold and a beam follows your finger.

items.name: social-login-solid
items.title: Social Login Solid
items.description: Stacked Continue with buttons in each provider's own color, with a pressable lip, a sheen while connecting and a Last used tag. The glyphs are simplified line icons, and any provider can take a custom icon.

items.name: social-login-outline
items.title: Social Login Outline
items.description: Quiet outline buttons whose border is traced in the provider color from two opposite corners on hover, while the glyph tints and an arrow slides in. While connecting, a dash keeps circling the border.

items.name: social-login-glass
items.title: Social Login Glass
items.description: Frosted glass pills with a light streak that follows the pointer and a blurred orb of the provider color glowing from behind. While connecting, the orb sweeps back and forth and a ring spins around the glyph.

items.name: social-login-icon-row
items.title: Social Login Icon Row
items.description: A compact toolbar of provider tiles with a tinted highlight that springs to the hovered or focused tile and a caption that rolls to Continue with the provider. Arrow keys, Home and End move between tiles.

items.name: social-login-icon-fill
items.title: Social Login Icon Fill
items.description: Each glyph sits in a small well that fills with the provider color like liquid on hover, with a moving wave on the surface and the glyph turning to the contrast color. While connecting, the liquid sloshes up and down.

items.name: social-login-color-wash
items.title: Social Login Color Wash
items.description: A grid of provider buttons where the brand color washes in as a circle from the exact point the pointer enters and drains toward the point it leaves. While connecting, stripes run across and a bar fills along the bottom.

items.name: social-share-dial
items.title: Social Share Dial
items.description: Press and hold the share button, drag toward a channel on the ring that opens around it and release to share. A tap keeps the ring open for clicking, and the keyboard opens it with Enter and moves with the arrow keys.

items.name: social-share-counter
items.title: Social Share Counter
items.description: A share total with odometer digits, a breakdown bar by channel and a chip per channel with its own count. Sharing rolls both numbers, grows the segment and floats a +1 from the chip.

items.name: social-share-morph
items.title: Social Share Morph
items.description: A Share pill that stretches in place into a toolbar of channels and a copy link field, with the share icon turning into a close icon. Copying sweeps a green fill under the link and confirms with a check.

items.name: social-follow-count
items.title: Social Follow Count
items.description: A Follow button joined to the follower count, where following rolls the digits up by one and slides your avatar into the front of the stack. The label flips to Following with a check that draws itself.

items.name: social-subscribe-bell
items.title: Social Subscribe Bell
items.description: A Subscribe button that settles into Subscribed and slides out a bell that rings, with a menu for all uploads, highlights only, no notifications or unsubscribe. The bell glyph changes with the chosen mode.

items.name: social-follow-avatar
items.title: Social Follow Avatar
items.description: A creator chip where the avatar itself is the follow button: the plus badge spins into a check, a ring draws around the photo, sparks fly out and the follower count rolls up. Clicking again unfollows.

items.name: button-hold-shred
items.title: Button Hold Shred
items.description: Press and hold to feed the label into a shredder slot while paper strips grow out of the bottom edge. Letting go early pulls the label back; finishing drops the strips and confirms.

items.name: button-slide-delete
items.title: Button Slide Delete
items.description: A slide-to-delete track where the thumb eats the label as it travels and the bin at the end opens its lid. Release past the threshold and the thumb drops into the bin while a red pill wipes in.

items.name: button-trash-lid
items.title: Button Trash Lid
items.description: A pill button with a little bin whose lid tips open on hover. Clicking drops a sheet of paper inside, the lid slams with a squash and a counter badge pops up.

items.name: button-safety-cover
items.title: Button Safety Cover
items.description: A red button sealed under a hazard-striped glass cover. The first press flips the cover up on its hinge, the second press within the time window confirms.

items.name: button-type-confirm
items.title: Button Type Confirm
items.description: Type the resource name to unlock the delete button. Each matched character lights up in the name, a wrong key shakes the field and the lock icon springs open on a full match.

items.name: button-delete-undo
items.title: Button Delete Undo
items.description: Deleting blurs the button away and slides in a toast with a draining bar, an Undo button and a Cmd+Z shortcut. If the window runs out the deletion is committed.

items.name: button-check-draw
items.title: Button Check Draw
items.description: The button folds into a circle, a ring spins while the action runs, then closes, fills and draws a checkmark before opening back up with the result. Accepts an async handler.

items.name: button-shift-arm
items.title: Button Shift Arm
items.description: A delete button that only fires while Shift is held. A plain click shakes it harder each time and pops a hint with a pressing keycap; holding Shift turns it into a striped red button.

items.name: button-countdown-abort
items.title: Button Countdown Abort
items.description: Starts a short countdown with a rolling digit and a strip of LED segments that switch off every half second. Clicking again or pressing Escape aborts before anything happens.

items.name: button-archive-discard
items.title: Button Archive Discard
items.description: A paired control where the hovered side stretches and the other shrinks to its icon. Archive drops a page into a box, Discard crushes its cross into a checkmark and takes the full width.

items.name: button-swipe-dissolve
items.title: Button Swipe Dissolve
items.description: A list row you drag left over a red well whose bin pops once you pass the threshold. On release the row dissolves into drifting particles from right to left, then the space collapses.

items.name: button-irreversible
items.title: Button Irreversible
items.description: A two-step danger row that expands in place into a warning with marching hazard stripes, a list of consequences and a checkbox. The final button stays locked until the user acknowledges.

items.name: modal-zoom-origin
items.title: Zoom Origin Dialog
items.description: A centered dialog that grows out of the exact button that opened it and shrinks back into it on close. Ships as a deploy confirmation with branch, checks and a publish button that fills while it works.

items.name: modal-bottom-sheet
items.title: Snap Bottom Sheet
items.description: A draggable bottom sheet with peek and full snap points, velocity-aware flicks and drag down to dismiss. The default content is a ride picker with a radio list and a sticky confirm button.

items.name: modal-side-sheet
items.title: Stacked Side Sheet
items.description: A side sheet for order details that opens a second sheet on top for refunds while the first one recedes behind it. Escape and Back peel the layers off one at a time.

items.name: modal-fullscreen-menu
items.title: Fullscreen Reveal Menu
items.description: A fullscreen navigation overlay that opens as a circle growing from the menu button, with oversized links rising in sequence. Hovering one link dims the rest and slides in an arrow.

items.name: dialog-session-alert
items.title: Session Timeout Alert
items.description: An alert dialog with a draining countdown ring that turns red in the last ten seconds and signs the user out at zero. Clicking the backdrop nudges the dialog instead of dismissing it.

items.name: dialog-transfer-confirm
items.title: Transfer Confirm Dialog
items.description: A high-stakes confirmation that shows ownership moving between two people and stays locked until the user ticks an acknowledgement. On success the crown hops from one avatar to the other.

items.name: dialog-create-project
items.title: Create Project Dialog
items.description: A form dialog with a live URL preview that checks slug availability as you type, a sliding team switch and visibility cards. It shakes on invalid input, submits with Command Enter and resizes smoothly into a success state.

items.name: modal-lightbox-zoom
items.title: Zoom Lightbox
items.description: A photo lightbox opened from a mosaic grid, with directional slides, a filmstrip and click to zoom that pans with the pointer. Arrow keys, swipe, Z for zoom and I for details all work.

items.name: modal-video-chapters
items.title: Chapter Video Modal
items.description: A video modal with a scrubber split into chapters, hover previews of each chapter, synced captions and speed control. Without a src it plays a styled preview timeline, so it works before the video exists.

items.name: modal-command-pages
items.title: Nested Command Modal
items.description: A command modal where items open sub-pages, shown as breadcrumb chips inside the search field, and Backspace walks back out. Searching from the root also finds options nested one level down.

items.name: modal-onboarding-steps
items.title: Onboarding Stepper Modal
items.description: A three step onboarding modal: pick a role, name and color the workspace, then invite teammates as email chips. Steps slide in the direction you move and the dialog height follows the content.

items.name: modal-success-check
items.title: Success Check Modal
items.description: A payment success modal that draws its ring and check, throws a small spark burst and counts the amount up. The receipt-style card ends in a perforated edge with a staggered list of details.

items.name: popover-rich
items.title: Rich Popover
items.description: A deployment chip that opens a detailed popover with status, commit, a proportional build timeline and quick actions. It flips above or below and nudges sideways to stay on screen while the arrow keeps pointing at the trigger.

items.name: popover-hover-profile
items.title: Hover Profile Card
items.description: An @mention that shows a profile card on hover, with an underline that fills while the open delay runs and a grace period so the pointer can travel into the card. Includes a contribution grid, a follow toggle with a live count and keyboard access on focus.

items.name: popup-newsletter-envelope
items.title: Newsletter Envelope Popup
items.description: A newsletter popup where the letter slides into an envelope, the flap folds shut and a seal stamps down once the address is accepted. Topic toggles, inline validation with a shake and an async submit are built in.

items.name: popup-cookie-preferences
items.title: Cookie Preferences
items.description: A cookie consent card or bottom bar with a segmented dial that counts the enabled categories, a Customize panel that expands in place with switches and vendor lists, and a small launcher with a receipt id after saving.

items.name: popup-exit-intent
items.title: Exit Intent Popup
items.description: Opens when the pointer leaves through the top of the window and reminds the visitor of their bag. The coupon stub tears off when pulled down or tapped, revealing a code that can be copied and a discounted total.

items.name: popup-promo-countdown
items.title: Promo Countdown Popup
items.description: A limited-time offer inside a rotating light border, with rolling digit reels for the countdown, a striped claimed-seats bar and a CTA with a sheen. It switches to an ended state when the timer reaches zero.

items.name: popup-upgrade-limit
items.title: Upgrade Limit Prompt
items.description: Shown when a usage limit is reached: a segmented meter that fills to the red, a queued overflow tag, a billing switch with a sliding thumb and plan cards whose prices roll and whose features check in one by one.

items.name: popup-tour-spotlight
items.title: Tour Spotlight
items.description: Wraps any screen and walks through it step by step: a rounded spotlight glides between targets while everything else dims, and the step card follows with a pointer tail, progress pills and arrow key navigation.

items.name: popup-whats-new
items.title: What's New Stories
items.description: A release announcement told as stories: segmented bars fill and advance on their own, pause on hover or keyboard focus, and each update brings an animated illustration that slides in from the direction you move.

items.name: popover-radial-menu
items.title: Radial Context Menu
items.description: A context menu that opens as a ring of wedges around the pointer on right-click, long-press or Shift F10. Aim toward a wedge to select it, read the label in the hub, and confirm with a click or Enter.

items.name: popup-island-notification
items.title: Island Notification
items.description: A notification pill at the top of the screen that morphs into a card with a springy resize, then into an inline reply field. Messages queue with an unread count, collapse on a paused-on-hover timer and end in an All caught up state.

items.name: popup-share-access
items.title: Share Access Dialog
items.description: A document sharing dialog with email chips that validate as you type or paste, a permission picker, a people list with role changes and removal, and a general access switch whose lock turns into a globe.

items.name: field-card-number
items.title: Card Number Field
items.description: A single-line card field that detects the brand, checks the number with Luhn and then folds it down to the last four digits while expiry and security code slide in. The tiny card glyph flips to its back when the security code has focus.

items.name: field-phone-country
items.title: Phone Field with Country
items.description: A phone input with a searchable country picker and a per-country mask whose remaining digits show as faint ghost characters. Pasting a number that starts with a dial code switches the country on its own.

items.name: input-date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date field that understands plain words like tomorrow, next fri, Dec 3 or +10d and previews the parsed date as you type, with a calendar that slides between months. The grid supports arrows, Page Up and Down, Home and End.

items.name: input-date-range
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A range picker where you drag across days or click a start and an end, with a live preview band that wraps across weeks and a preset column. A running total of days or nights sits above the Apply button.

items.name: select-combobox-async
items.title: Async Combobox
items.description: A searchable combobox that debounces input, shows shimmering skeleton rows while results load and drops stale responses. Matches are underlined, rows stagger in and the footer reports the result count and how long the search took.

items.name: field-autosize-textarea
items.title: Autosize Textarea
items.description: A textarea that grows smoothly with its content up to a row limit, with a ring counter that turns amber near the limit and red past it. Characters over the limit are tinted in place, and Cmd or Ctrl plus Enter sends.

items.name: input-file-drop
items.title: File Drop Upload
items.description: An upload zone in three variants, panel, strip and round avatar, with a marching dashed border on drag and a lifting icon. Each file gets a typed document glyph, a progress ring and a bottom progress line, and rejected files shake with the reason.

items.name: input-color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A color picker with a saturation and brightness pad, hue and opacity sliders, a HEX, RGB and HSL field and swatches. It shows the original next to the new color and grades contrast against your background with WCAG AA and AAA.

items.name: input-time-picker
items.title: Clock Time Picker
items.description: A time picker with an analog dial: drag the hand to the hour and it moves on to minutes, which snap to a step. A large readout, an AM and PM switch and full keyboard control sit beside it.

items.name: field-currency
items.title: Currency Field
items.description: A money input where digits fill from the right like a register, each new digit rolling in, formatted live for the locale and currency. It shows a converted estimate, quick add chips and a balance limit that shakes when crossed.

items.name: input-search-filters
items.title: Search with Filters
items.description: A search field that turns key:value syntax into colored filter tokens, suggesting filter names and then their values as you type. Prefix with a minus to exclude, click a token to edit it, and press Backspace twice to remove the last one.

items.name: input-signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A signature pad whose line thins with speed and thickens when you slow down, drawn as smooth curves at full screen resolution. It has ink colors, undo, a typed alternative and a signed stamp with the time.

items.name: form-contact
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: A routed contact form where the topic switch reshapes the fields and the reply time. Inline validation, a message progress ring and a paper plane success state with a ticket number.

items.name: form-signup
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: Account creation with a live username availability check, email typo suggestions and four password checks that fill as bars. Ends on an animated envelope with a resend countdown.

items.name: form-wizard
items.title: Wizard Form
items.description: A four step onboarding wizard with a segmented progress rail, direction aware slides and a review step with edit links. Creating the workspace plays a short setup checklist.

items.name: form-survey
items.title: Survey Form
items.description: One question at a time with an NPS scale, lettered choices and keyboard shortcuts. Picks confirm with a quick blink and advance on their own, ending on a summary with the score group.

items.name: form-address
items.title: Address Form
items.description: A shipping address form that adapts labels, postal masks and line order to the country. A parcel label above it prints the address as you type and stamps it once saved.

items.name: form-settings
items.title: Settings Form
items.description: Account settings that track every edit: changed fields get a dot and a floating bar counts unsaved changes with Reset and Save. Supports Cmd+S and confirms with a green saved state.

items.name: form-feedback
items.title: Feedback Widget
items.description: A launcher pill that opens a feedback panel with a face whose mouth and brows morph across a five step mood scale. Category, note and page URL go out in one tap.

items.name: form-subscribe-inline
items.title: Inline Subscribe
items.description: A one line newsletter field where the button sweeps across the input while it subscribes, then turns into a confirmation with a shortcut to the right inbox. Invalid emails shake and raise a tooltip.

items.name: form-booking
items.title: Booking Form
items.description: Pick a day from a strip with availability marks, choose a free slot, then add your details. Confirms with a perforated ticket and an Add to calendar file.

items.name: form-waitlist
items.title: Waitlist Form
items.description: A waitlist form with a live priority meter: every optional answer moves your estimated spot forward and up through access tiers. Joining reveals a referral link with copy feedback.

items.name: form-login-compact
items.title: Compact Login
items.description: Email first sign in that slides to a password step with the account chip, a caps lock badge and attempt pips. Too many misses lock the form with a countdown.

items.name: form-profile-edit
items.title: Profile Edit
items.description: A profile you edit in place, one row at a time, with Enter to save and Escape to cancel. A completion ring and hint track what is missing, and the avatar opens a color picker.

items.name: navbar-prism-glass
items.title: Navbar Prism Glass
items.description: A floating frosted bar whose blur, tint and shadow deepen as the page scrolls, with a specular sheen and a lit rim that follow the pointer. The active link carries a softly pulsing glow dot.

items.name: navbar-morph-underline
items.title: Navbar Morph Underline
items.description: A documentation header whose underline crawls between links like an inchworm: the leading edge moves first and the trailing edge catches up. On narrow screens the links become a scrollable tab strip that keeps the same underline.

items.name: navbar-magnetic
items.title: Navbar Magnetic
items.description: A studio header where every link leans toward the pointer and a soft chip stretches after it, then springs back with a slight overshoot. The call to action has a stronger pull and an arrow that straightens on hover.

items.name: navbar-spotlight
items.title: Navbar Spotlight
items.description: A pitch-black bar lit only where the pointer is: a flashlight reveals a dot grid, makes nearby labels glow and runs a beam along the bottom edge. Touch moves the light too, and idleAt can park it for a static hero.

items.name: navbar-scroll-shrink
items.title: Navbar Scroll Shrink
items.description: An editorial masthead with a utility row, a large centered wordmark and a sections row that folds into a floating compact bar on scroll. The wordmark glides to the left, the sections rise into the same row and a ring around search tracks reading progress.

items.name: navbar-mega-preview
items.title: Navbar Mega Preview
items.description: A header whose menus open a two-pane panel: a list of destinations on the left and a live illustrated preview on the right that redraws for whichever item is hovered or focused. Switching menus slides the list in the direction of travel.

items.name: navbar-command
items.title: Navbar Command
items.description: An app header with a search field that stretches across the whole bar on focus or Cmd K, pushing the links aside and dropping grouped results with highlighted matches. Arrow keys move, Enter opens and Escape clears, then closes.

items.name: navbar-hamburger-morph
items.title: Navbar Hamburger Morph
items.description: A studio header with a Menu pill whose lines fold into a cross while the label rolls to Close, and a full-screen menu that grows out of the button in a circle. Oversized numbered links rise in sequence, with contact, socials and availability beside them.

items.name: navbar-banner-stories
items.title: Navbar Banner Stories
items.description: A header topped by an announcement strip that plays like stories: segments fill over time, messages roll vertically and hover pauses the run. Dismissing folds the strip away, and the bar below carries a tracking number field with validation.

items.name: navbar-split-logo
items.title: Navbar Split Logo
items.description: A fashion header with the logo centered between two link groups. Hovering a link draws a fine line from the logo out to it and turns the star mark toward that side, and the bag count pops when it changes.

items.name: navbar-floating-capsule
items.title: Navbar Floating Capsule
items.description: Three floating capsules for the brand, the links and the actions that glide together into one pill once the page scrolls. On small screens the pill itself grows into the menu, with staggered links and two full-width buttons.

items.name: navbar-vertical-rail
items.title: Navbar Vertical Rail
items.description: A header turned on its side: a sticky left rail with rotated, numbered links, a glowing marker that slides to the current page and a round call to action. Under 640px it becomes a top bar with a clip-path menu of large numbered links.

items.name: navbar-tabs-stretch
items.title: Navbar Tabs Stretch
items.description: A project header with a row of tabs whose underline stretches like elastic: the leading edge races ahead and the trailing edge catches up. A ghost pill follows the pointer, counts sit in badges and the row scrolls with faded edges on phones.

items.name: navbar-search-first
items.title: Navbar Search First
items.description: A docs header built around search: the field widens and pushes the links out of the way, scope chips show live counts, matches are highlighted and every result is reachable by keyboard. On phones a search button sweeps open into a full-width field with Cancel.

items.name: navbar-bottom-notch
items.title: Navbar Bottom Notch
items.description: A mobile bottom bar with a notch cut into the plate that slides to the selected tab, where the icon pops up into a floating accent bubble. Badges, a dot state, arrow keys and safe-area spacing are built in.

items.name: navbar-commerce-rows
items.title: Navbar Commerce Rows
items.description: A three-tier store header: a rotating message strip, a row with search, account and a cart that opens a mini cart with quantity steppers and a free shipping meter, and a category row with mega panels. Phones get a stacked layout, scrolling chips and an accordion drawer.

items.name: navbar-theme-reveal
items.title: Navbar Theme Reveal
items.description: A navbar with a sun and moon switch that repaints the page with a circular wipe starting from the toggle itself. The icon morphs between moon and sun, and the new theme is committed when the wipe lands.

items.name: navbar-hero-fill
items.title: Navbar Hero Fill
items.description: A transparent navbar over a full-bleed hero that fills in proportion to scroll: the background, blur, shadow, text color and height all follow one progress value instead of snapping. On phones a circular overlay opens with large staggered links and a focus trap.

items.name: navbar-dock-stacks
items.title: Navbar Dock Stacks
items.description: A dock across the top of an app whose tiles swell toward the pointer and bounce when pressed. Folder items open a stack that fans out in an arc of cards, which turns into a plain list sheet on phones.

items.name: navbar-breadcrumb-switcher
items.title: Navbar Breadcrumb Switcher
items.description: An app header where each breadcrumb is a switcher: team, project and environment open searchable lists with keyboard control. Picking a team cascades to its first project and environment, and changed crumbs swap in with a short blur.

items.name: sidebar-resizable
items.title: Sidebar Resizable
items.description: An app sidebar you resize by dragging its edge, with a live width readout that snaps it into an icon rail below a threshold. Collapsed, every item shows a tooltip with its label and shortcut.

items.name: menu-side-push
items.title: Menu Side Push
items.description: An off-canvas menu that pushes the page aside as a scaled, rounded card with a ghost card behind it, revealing large numbered links. The burger morphs into a cross, focus stays trapped and Escape closes.

items.name: sidebar-accordion-rail
items.title: Sidebar Accordion Rail
items.description: Docs-style accordion groups where only one opens at a time and its links hang from a curved branch line. A glowing bead slides to the current page while the line fills to show reading progress.

items.name: sidebar-fisheye
items.title: Sidebar Fisheye
items.description: A vertical rail of glossy app tiles that swell under the pointer like a lens, with a floating label that glides to the nearest tile. Keyboard focus drives the same magnification.

items.name: sidebar-glass-aurora
items.title: Sidebar Glass Aurora
items.description: A frosted glass sidebar floating over slowly drifting aurora light, with a soft light that follows the pointer down the list. The active row is a raised glass pill with a bright top edge.

items.name: sidebar-command
items.title: Sidebar Command
items.description: A keyboard-first sidebar with a fuzzy filter and two-key chords like G then I, shown in a status bar that drains while it waits for the second key. Built for power users who never touch the mouse.

items.name: sidebar-quick-find
items.title: Sidebar Quick Find
items.description: A settings sidebar whose search folds away every page and section that does not match, also searching hidden keywords and showing which one matched. Enter opens the first hit and an empty search suggests terms.

items.name: sidebar-account-card
items.title: Sidebar Account Card
items.description: A sidebar whose account card grows upward into a panel with a status switch, workspace picker, seat meter and sign out. The avatar ring takes the status color and the nav behind softly blurs.
