items.name: sidebar-flyout-rail
items.title: Sidebar Flyout Rail
items.description: An icon rail that opens a flyout of sub-links beside the hovered icon, gliding and resizing between sections with content sliding in the direction you moved. Arrow keys open, walk and close it.

items.name: menu-side-bottom-sheet
items.title: Menu Side Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile menu in a bottom sheet you drag between half and full height, or flick down to dismiss, with quick action tiles above the links. The backdrop darkens with the sheet and focus stays inside while it is open.

items.name: hero-scroll-expand
items.title: Hero Scroll Expand
items.description: A framed film still grows from a small card to the full viewport while the headline splits apart and blurs out. A timecode, caption and play button settle onto the expanded frame.

items.name: hero-scroll-morph
items.title: Hero Scroll Morph
items.description: Twelve app tiles start scattered around the headline, then snap into a grid, bend into an arc and collapse into a single stack as you scroll. The last line of the headline swaps with each layout.

items.name: hero-scroll-horizontal
items.title: Hero Scroll Horizontal
items.description: A pinned hero that turns vertical scroll into a sideways story, from an intro panel through illustrated chapters with parallax numerals. A chapter rail at the bottom fills as you travel.

items.name: hero-scroll-letters
items.title: Hero Scroll Letters
items.description: A giant word cut out of a black plate shows a night sky through its letters, then the camera flies through the O until the whole sky fills the screen. The real headline and booking pill fade in on the other side.

items.name: hero-scroll-curtain
items.title: Hero Scroll Curtain
items.description: A velvet stage curtain printed with a gold title gathers to both sides as you scroll, its folds bunching and hems lifting. Behind it the spotlight comes up on the season, the buttons and three show cards.

items.name: hero-scroll-stack
items.title: Hero Scroll Stack
items.description: A split hero where product panels slide up one over another and the ones underneath tilt back, shrink and dim into a deck. The step list on the left follows the panel on top.

items.name: hero-scroll-mask
items.title: Hero Scroll Mask
items.description: An event name starts so large that only a slice of its painted fill is visible, then shrinks into place while the image inside keeps panning. The top bar, facts row and ticket button assemble around it.

items.name: hero-scroll-ring
items.title: Hero Scroll Ring
items.description: A ring of product cards seen from above tilts up to eye level and turns as you scroll. The piece facing you is named in the footer with its number and price.

items.name: hero-scroll-wipe
items.title: Hero Scroll Wipe
items.description: A slanted wipe line sweeps across the whole hero and turns a gray spreadsheet version of the page into a polished live dashboard, headline included. A glowing handle on the line counts the progress.

items.name: hero-scroll-timeline
items.title: Hero Scroll Timeline
items.description: A winding line draws itself down the right side as you scroll, lighting milestone nodes and their cards one by one. On the left a year and a running total count up in step.

items.name: hero-scroll-split
items.title: Hero Scroll Split
items.description: A two-line headline on warm paper pulls apart while a slit between the lines opens into a wide view through whitewashed arches. Location, price and a booking button settle at the bottom.

items.name: hero-scroll-depth
items.title: Hero Scroll Depth
items.description: A dusk mountain scene in five layers, sky, far ridge, dolomite towers, wooded hills and foreground pines, with the headline tucked between them. Scrolling pushes the camera in and each layer moves at its own depth.

items.name: hero-prism
items.title: Hero Prism
items.description: A glass prism catches a beam of white light and fans it into a living spectrum behind the headline, with a spectrometer scale along the bottom. The spectrum sways on its own and tilts toward the pointer.

items.name: hero-glass-orbs
items.title: Hero Glass Orbs
items.description: Clear glass spheres float beside the copy and bend the grid behind them, each with a mirrored lens image, chromatic rim, caustic and a tinted shadow. The orbs drift in depth with the pointer.

items.name: hero-stage-light
items.title: Hero Stage Light
items.description: A product launch stage: a single fixture sweeps a cone of warm light with drifting dust across a dark room, the pool of light follows on the floor and a sheen glides over the product. Specs sit on a ruled base line.

items.name: hero-kinetic
items.title: Hero Kinetic
items.description: A poster-scale typographic hero with three lines that each move differently: letters pump like an equalizer, an outlined line slides as a marquee and a color wave runs through the last line, whose letters flip on hover.

items.name: hero-devices
items.title: Hero Devices
items.description: A laptop lid swings open to reveal a live board, then a phone slides in with notifications and a progress chip pops up. Each device sits on its own depth layer and drifts with the pointer.

items.name: hero-gradient-sphere
items.title: Hero Gradient Sphere
items.description: A split hero with a lit 3D sphere whose gradient mesh swirls inside it, a turning wireframe, an orbit ring with a moon that passes behind, and a row of palette tokens beside the copy.

items.name: hero-terminal
items.title: Hero Terminal
items.description: A developer hero led by a large terminal that types a command and plays a deploy session line by line, with a filling progress bar, check marks and a live URL, then loops. A copyable command sits above it.

items.name: hero-card-wall
items.title: Hero Card Wall
items.description: Five columns of integration cards scroll in alternating directions on a tilted 3D plane behind the copy, some lit and syncing. The wall fades into the page under the headline.

items.name: hero-live-metrics
items.title: Hero Live Metrics
items.description: A hero that ends in a working dashboard: revenue ticks up, the line chart slides a new point in every beat and fresh payments drop into the feed. It pauses offscreen and holds still for reduced motion.

items.name: hero-aurora-lit
items.title: Hero Aurora Lit
items.description: A giant dark headline silhouetted against a drifting aurora, rim-lit like an eclipse, with a faint reflection on a glowing horizon line. Quiet, nocturnal and built around the type.

items.name: hero-light-ribbon
items.title: Hero Light Ribbon
items.description: A twisting ribbon of fine light strands sweeps from the bottom of the frame to the top corner, breathing slowly while bright pulses race along it. Copy and stats sit in the open space.

items.name: hero-swiss
items.title: Hero Swiss
items.description: A minimal editorial hero on paper with a visible twelve-column grid, a huge tight headline that rises line by line, a single accent dot and a numbered index of services. Light by default, with a dark variant.

items.name: cinema-title-card
items.title: Cinema Title Card
items.description: An opening title card with anamorphic letterbox bars that close in, a slow push-in on a dusk desert road and a title that settles from wide tracking. A compressed billing block and the release line sit inside the bottom bar.

items.name: cinema-trailer-slam
items.title: Cinema Trailer Slam
items.description: Teaser-style words slam into frame one beat at a time with a camera shake, a white flash and an anamorphic flare, then resolve into the title and release date. It loops for showcases or plays once.

items.name: cinema-credits-roll
items.title: Cinema Credits Roll
items.description: End credits that roll up a dark frame with roles and names aligned on a center gutter, cast and crew sections and a closing studio mark. Hovering or pressing Pause stops the roll.

items.name: cinema-aperture-open
items.title: Cinema Aperture Open
items.description: A camera diaphragm of overlapping metal blades rotates open to reveal a city at dusk and the title, with a live f-stop readout. It cycles by itself or opens and closes on demand.

items.name: cinema-light-leak
items.title: Cinema Light Leak
items.description: A golden-hour coastline shot on film, with warm light leaks drifting across the frame, an edge burn, moving grain, gate weave and a running timecode. The caption sits low on the left like a home-movie title.

items.name: cinema-projector-intro
items.title: Cinema Projector Intro
items.description: A dark theater where the projector beam flickers on over the audience, dust drifts through the light and the screen runs a reel card before the title appears with scratches and flicker. Built for film clubs and screening nights.

items.name: cinema-depth-fog
items.title: Cinema Depth Fog
items.description: Five mountain ridges at different depths with fog banks drifting between them, a pale sun and birds crossing the sky. Each layer shifts with the pointer by its own depth, and an altitude scale runs down the right edge.

items.name: cinema-split-reveal
items.title: Cinema Split Reveal
items.description: A split-screen poster for two leads, a rain-soaked night harbor against a desert at dusk, divided by a glowing diagonal seam. Hovering or focusing a side pushes the seam across, opens that character's line and recolors the shared title.

items.name: cinema-countdown-leader
items.title: Cinema Countdown Leader
items.description: A film leader countdown with a sweeping dial, crosshairs and frame labels that ticks down once per second, pops a white frame and gives way to the event details. It can be skipped and replayed.

items.name: cinema-subtitles
items.title: Cinema Subtitles
items.description: A night drive scene with streetlights sweeping through the cabin and subtitles synced to a timeline, with speaker labels, sound cues and a scrubber that marks every line. Play, pause, seek and toggle captions.

items.name: cinema-dolly-zoom
items.title: Cinema Dolly Zoom
items.description: A true dolly zoom down a hallway of door frames: the figure at the end keeps its size while the corridor stretches and compresses around it, with focal length and dolly distance readouts. Runs by itself or follows a progress value.

items.name: cinema-chapter-select
items.title: Cinema Chapter Select
items.description: A chapter menu with illustrated poster cards, watched progress and a backdrop that crossfades to the colors of the chosen chapter. Arrow keys move between chapters and the play button resumes where the viewer stopped.

items.name: cinema-now-showing
items.title: Cinema Now Showing
items.description: A now-showing section with a poster, film facts and a paper ticket where the visitor picks a date, a showtime and the number of seats. Booking tears the stub off and prints the row, seats and a barcode.

items.name: cinema-marquee-sign
items.title: Cinema Marquee Sign
items.description: A theater facade in 3D with a neon crown, a vertical blade sign that spells the venue, chasing bulbs and a backlit letter board whose tiles swing onto their rails for each new program. The sign tilts with the pointer.

items.name: bg-polar-veil
items.title: Polar Veil
items.description: Aurora curtains made of fine vertical rays that sway and shimmer over a night ridge, with twinkling stars and a light film grain. Pure CSS and SVG, no canvas.

items.name: bg-flow-paths
items.title: Flow Paths
items.description: A bundle of SVG curves that crosses the frame and twists through a pinch point, with bright glints racing along random strands. The whole bundle breathes slowly.

items.name: bg-contour-lines
items.title: Contour Lines
items.description: A survey map of slowly reshaping hills: nested contour lines that merge where hills meet, bolder index lines with elevation labels, summit markers and edge ticks.

items.name: bg-warp-stars
items.title: Warp Stars
items.description: A 3D starfield that cruises, spools up into streaking light speed with a blue-shifted core, then drops out with a flash. Can also hold a fixed warp level.

items.name: bg-mesh-lattice
items.title: Mesh Lattice
items.description: A smooth mesh gradient whose color points drift on their own paths, drawn with the lattice and handles of a design tool. One handle at a time is selected and shows its color value.

items.name: bg-grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient
items.description: Warm color fields that drift and blend under a heavy, tactile grain with soft mottling, like a risograph print. The grain can flicker like film or stay still.

items.name: bg-grid-beams
items.title: Grid Beams
items.description: A fine grid lit from the top, with beams of light that shoot along its lines and sparks that flash at the crossings. Beams snap to the grid at any size.

items.name: bg-beacon-rings
items.title: Beacon Rings
items.description: Segmented rings that launch from a pulsing core and rotate as they expand, over faint guide circles and a crosshair. Each launch kicks the core.

items.name: bg-wave-lines
items.title: Wave Lines
items.description: Rows of thin lines in perspective that ripple like a sheet of fabric, with near rows hiding the far ones. A swell travels across and lights the crests in the accent color.

items.name: bg-bokeh
items.title: Bokeh
items.description: Out-of-focus light discs with bright rims that drift upward while a slow focus pull sweeps through the depth, turning near discs into crisp points and far ones into soft glows.

items.name: bg-spotlight-grid
items.title: Spotlight Grid
items.description: A dim grid where a spotlight follows the pointer, or roams on its own, and reveals bright lines, crossing dots and glowing tiles that blink on and off.

items.name: bg-glow-orbs
items.title: Glow Orbs
items.description: Glossy lit spheres with halos that float on slow orbits and change depth, reflected on a dark polished floor below them.

items.name: bg-horizon-rise
items.title: Horizon Rise
items.description: A sun rising behind the curved edge of a planet: the atmosphere rim brightens, a lens streak spreads along the horizon and the stars fade. Loops or rises once and holds.

items.name: bg-soft-clouds
items.title: Soft Clouds
items.description: Three layers of shaded clouds, lit on top and tinted underneath, drifting at different speeds over a sky with a low sun glow. Comes in dusk, night and day.

items.name: bg-halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: A moving gradient printed as a two-ink halftone: each ink has its own screen angle and a slight misregistration, and the dots swell and shrink as the tones drift.

items.name: bg-metaballs
items.title: Metaballs
items.description: Glossy two-tone blobs that drift, merge and split like a lava lamp, with a bright rim and a specular edge where they meet the light. The field is computed at low resolution and scaled up smoothly, so it stays light on the CPU.

items.name: bg-flow-field
items.title: Flow Field
items.description: Thousands of particles follow a slowly shifting vector field and leave fading trails, tinted from one color to another by their heading. The pointer stirs a local eddy into the current.

items.name: bg-voronoi
items.title: Voronoi Cells
items.description: A tiling of drifting Voronoi cells separated by thin gaps, each shaded like a glass tile. Cells light up one by one, a soft band sweeps across them, and the cell under the pointer glows.

items.name: bg-dot-swell
items.title: Dot Swell
items.description: A perspective sea of dots rolling under interfering swells, with crests brightening toward the accent color and the far rows fading into fog at the horizon.

items.name: bg-glyph-rain
items.title: Glyph Rain
items.description: Falling columns of glyphs on three depth planes, with bright flickering heads, long fading tails and a slow scan line that lifts the glyphs it crosses. Choose hex, binary, block or symbol glyphs, or pass your own.

items.name: bg-circuit
items.title: Circuit Traces
items.description: A procedurally routed circuit board with 45-degree traces, pads and chip packages. Pulses of light travel along the traces and flash the pad they arrive at.

items.name: bg-liquid-chrome
items.title: Liquid Chrome
items.description: A slowly warping surface of polished chrome with sky, horizon and ground reflections banded across the folds, lightly tinted by an accent color.

items.name: bg-cloth
items.title: Satin Cloth
items.description: A sheet of satin rippling in a slow breeze, lit per facet with soft diffuse light and a narrow sheen that slides along the folds.

items.name: bg-crystal-facets
items.title: Crystal Facets
items.description: A low-poly crystal surface whose facets breathe in depth while a light orbits above them. Facets that face the light glint, and a diagonal shimmer passes over the whole surface.

items.name: bg-lightning
items.title: Lightning Storm
items.description: A night storm with branching bolts that strike at random intervals, light up the clouds with a restrike and fade, over a layer of slanted rain.

items.name: bg-fireflies
items.title: Fireflies
items.description: Warm fireflies wander over a dusk meadow and blink on their own rhythms. Distant ones glow behind the grass and near ones float in front of it.

items.name: bg-vortex
items.title: Vortex Tunnel
items.description: Segmented rings rush toward the viewer through a twisting tunnel whose far end sways, with sparks spiraling along the walls and a glowing core.

items.name: bg-hex-pulse
items.title: Hex Pulse
items.description: A honeycomb grid where pulses ripple out from random cells, lighting outlines with a sharp leading edge and a slow afterglow. Moving or tapping the pointer sends a pulse from that spot.

items.name: bg-radar
items.title: Radar Scope
items.description: A phosphor radar display with range rings, bearing ticks and a rotating sweep. Contacts flare as the beam passes and fade until the next turn, some with track labels.

items.name: bg-helix-threads
items.title: Helix Threads
items.description: Double-helix threads cross the frame at different depths, twisting continuously with base-pair rungs between the strands and depth shading on every segment.

items.name: auth-tilt-spotlight
items.title: Auth Tilt Spotlight
items.description: A sign-in card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D, with a rotating conic border and a spotlight that follows the cursor across the surface. Includes SSO, email and password with validation, a loading sweep and a drawn success check.

items.name: auth-split-assemble
items.title: Auth Split Assemble
items.description: A split sign-in section whose isometric illustration responds to the form: three floating slabs drop and lock together as the email and password become valid, and a beam lights the stack on success. Captions and progress pips follow each step.

items.name: auth-aurora-glass
items.title: Auth Aurora Glass
items.description: A frosted glass sign-in card under drifting aurora curtains whose colors react to the form: one hue for the email field, another for the password, amber when Caps Lock is on and green on success. Floating labels, a stay-signed-in switch and a status line complete it.

items.name: auth-passkey-handshake
items.title: Auth Passkey Handshake
items.description: A passkey sign-in built around a dial of sixty ticks: a sweep while the browser looks for a passkey, a draining countdown ring while you confirm on your device, then every tick lights up as the signature is verified. A live checklist shows each step of the ceremony.

items.name: auth-magic-flight
items.title: Auth Magic Flight
items.description: A dark magic link sign-in where the letter folds into an envelope and flies along a dotted route into an inbox tray that catches it and shows a badge. The sent state has a live expiry bar, an Open mail button and a resend cooldown.

items.name: auth-social-orbit
items.title: Auth Social Orbit
items.description: A social-first sign-in where provider buttons circle the brand mark on a slow orbit that pauses on hover. Pointing at a provider draws a beam to the center, tints the scene and morphs the main button to Continue with that provider.

items.name: auth-status-rail
items.title: Auth Status Rail
items.description: A sign-in card with a live status rail beside the form: edge latency with a moving sparkline, workspace detection that switches to SSO for known domains, password policy, device trust and session issuance, each lighting up as you type.

items.name: auth-lock-reveal
items.title: Auth Lock Reveal
items.description: A vault unlock screen with a cutaway pin-tumbler padlock: each typed character sets a pin at the shear line, a key slides in on submit and the shackle springs open to reveal the vault contents. Wrong or short passwords shake the lock.

items.name: auth-flow-otp-verify
items.title: Auth Flow OTP Verify
items.description: A one-time code screen built on a single native input under a segmented rail: digits drop into their slots, a glowing bar glides to the next one and the code checks itself when complete. A delivery switch for text, email or call, a depleting resend ring, attempt limits and a verifying sweep complete the flow.

items.name: auth-flow-reset-password
items.title: Auth Flow Reset Password
items.description: A reset screen that measures strength in bits of entropy on a calibrated track and shows the password's makeup as colored tiles without revealing a character. It warns about reused or common passwords, points to the exact character where the confirmation differs, counts down the reset link and ends by listing the sessions it signed out.

items.name: auth-flow-two-factor-setup
items.title: Auth Flow Two-Factor Setup
items.description: A three-step authenticator setup: a scannable-looking code grid that ripples in with a scan line and a copyable setup key, a code check beside a ring synced to the 30-second window, and blurred backup codes that must be revealed and confirmed as stored before finishing.

items.name: auth-flow-new-device
items.title: Auth Flow New Device
items.description: A new sign-in review with a dotted map that traces an arc from the usual location to the new one, device facts and a number-matching challenge: tap the number shown on the other device to approve it. Blocking the attempt plays a checklist of the lockdown steps taken.

items.name: auth-flow-signup-wizard
items.title: Auth Flow Signup Wizard
items.description: A one-question-per-screen sign-up that slides each question in with a blur, advances on Enter and toggles choices with number keys. Beside it a member pass builds itself live from the answers, with a gradient avatar, workspace address, chosen uses and a stamp when the account is created.

items.name: auth-flow-lock-screen
items.title: Auth Flow Lock Screen
items.description: A device-style lock screen with rolling clock digits over a layered dusk wallpaper. Unlocking opens a frosted PIN pad that accepts the keyboard, shakes on a wrong PIN, locks out with a countdown ring after too many tries, and lifts away with an opening shackle on success.

items.name: auth-flow-team-invite
items.title: Auth Flow Team Invite
items.description: An invite acceptance that starts from a ticket with the inviter and member stack, creates the account with the email already verified, then turns into a token field for inviting teammates. Emails become chips with a role switch and an External tag, a seat meter fills as you add people, and sent chips fly into the member stack.

items.name: pricing-toggle-burst
items.title: Pricing Toggle Burst
items.description: Three plans with a spring-loaded monthly and yearly switch. Going yearly fires a burst of shards from the discount badge, strikes through the old price and slides in the yearly saving on every card.

items.name: pricing-usage-calculator
items.title: Pricing Usage Calculator
items.description: Four metered sliders with free allowances hatched on the track feed a live receipt with a stacked cost bar. It also points to the cheapest flat plan that covers the usage and shows the monthly saving.

items.name: pricing-spotlight-grid
items.title: Pricing Spotlight Grid
items.description: A single light follows the pointer across three plan cards, lighting their borders, inner surface and a dotted field in the gaps between them. When the pointer leaves, the light settles on a resting point.

items.name: pricing-matrix-sticky
items.title: Pricing Matrix Sticky
items.description: A full feature matrix in its own scroller whose plan header sticks and compacts as you scroll. Columns light up under the pointer and an Only show differences switch folds away rows every plan shares.

items.name: pricing-tier-carousel
items.title: Pricing Tier Carousel
items.description: Five plans in a 3D cover flow you can swipe, drag, click or drive with arrow keys. A price rail below places every tier on a log scale and a ring glides to the active one while the backdrop takes its color.

items.name: pricing-ribbon-highlight
items.title: Pricing Ribbon Highlight
items.description: One spinning gradient frame glides between plan cards as you hover or tab, then springs back to the selected plan. The best value plan wears a corner ribbon with a passing shine and the cards work as a radio group.

items.name: pricing-enterprise-contact
items.title: Pricing Enterprise Contact
items.description: An enterprise card with value points, compliance seals and customers beside a scoping form. Team size and add-ons update a ballpark annual contract live, and booking a call slot ends in a drawn confirmation.

items.name: pricing-credit-stack
items.title: Pricing Credit Stack
items.description: Credit packs as a radio list next to a stack of coins that grows and drops new coins in as you pick a bigger pack, with bonus credits glowing on top. Below, live counts show what the credits buy.

items.name: pricing-seat-stepper
items.title: Pricing Seat Stepper
items.description: A press-and-hold seat stepper that fills a row of teammate avatars while a dot climbs down a volume staircase chart. Price per seat, savings and the next price break update live, with a jump to the break.

items.name: pricing-single-plan
items.title: Pricing Single Plan
items.description: A minimal one-plan page with an oversized price, a slowly turning guarantee seal and a shining call to action. Every included feature ticks itself on in sequence when the section scrolls into view.

items.name: text-block-wipe
items.title: Text Block Wipe
items.description: Two stacked color bars sweep across each line, cover it and pull away to uncover the text, like an editorial title card. Lines run in sequence and the text settles with a short slide.

items.name: text-cipher-lock
items.title: Text Cipher Lock
items.description: Characters churn through cipher glyphs and lock one at a time in a shuffled order, each with a short accent flash and a tick underneath. Every glyph sits in a cell sized to the real letter, so the line never shifts.

items.name: text-weight-wave
items.title: Text Weight Wave
items.description: A swell of font weight rolls through the letters on a loop, tinting each one as the crest passes. Every letter reserves its boldest width, so the line keeps still while the weight moves.

items.name: text-letter-flip
items.title: Text Letter Flip
items.description: Each letter is a two-sided tile that turns over in a cascade to show the next word, with a small overshoot as it lands. Works on the horizontal or vertical axis and pauses on hover.

items.name: text-foil-sweep
items.title: Text Foil Sweep
items.description: Text printed like holographic foil: a metal base, a band of spectrum colors and a hard specular streak that sweeps across. With a mouse, the streak follows the pointer instead.

items.name: text-line-rise
items.title: Text Line Rise
items.description: Finds where the paragraph actually wraps and lifts each visual line out of its own mask with a skew that straightens on arrival. A hairline draws above each line just before it rises.

items.name: text-weight-trail
items.title: Text Weight Trail
items.description: Letters gain weight and color from how fast the pointer moves across them, then cool back down, so a quick swipe leaves a bold trail that fades. Optional autoplay sweeps a ghost pointer when idle.

items.name: text-path-flow
items.title: Text Path Flow
items.description: A line of text streams along a wave that slowly breathes and shifts, with a dotted guide underneath and soft fades at both ends. Drawn in SVG, so it scales cleanly to any width.

items.name: text-magnetic
items.title: Text Magnetic
items.description: Each letter hangs on its own spring and leans toward the pointer, tilting with its speed and wobbling back into place when released. Autoplay drives a small magnet across the line when nobody is pointing.

items.name: text-roll-words
items.title: Text Roll Words
items.description: Every letter position is a reel that rolls to the next word at its own speed, and each reel resizes to the exact width of its new letter. The cycle wraps without rewinding.

items.name: text-ink-draw
items.title: Text Ink Draw
items.description: The outline of each glyph draws itself like a pen stroke, then ink floods the letters from left to right and the outline settles into a faint keyline. Rendered in SVG and sized to the text.

items.name: text-rack-focus
items.title: Text Rack Focus
items.description: A camera focus pull across a line: the plane of focus travels in from the left, lands on a chosen word with a hint of chromatic fringe, then the depth of field opens until the whole line is sharp.

items.name: text-swap-pill
items.title: Text Swap Pill
items.description: A sentence with a tinted pill whose word tumbles out and in while the pill eases to the new width and color. A hairline inside the pill shows the time until the next word.

items.name: text-shatter
items.title: Text Shatter
items.description: Every letter splits into four shards that burst apart from the point you touch and spring back into a clean glyph. Works on hover and focus, as a click toggle, or on its own loop.

items.name: transition-iris-wipe
items.title: Transition Iris Wipe
items.description: A film-style iris that closes on the first view to a single point, holds on black for a beat, then opens on the second. A lit ring rides the aperture edge and the closing view sinks back as it goes.

items.name: transition-diagonal-slice
items.title: Transition Diagonal Slice
items.description: The next view arrives cut into slanted bands that slide in along their own angle, alternating from top and bottom. The view behind recedes and dims while the bands lock together.

items.name: transition-pixel-dissolve
items.title: Transition Pixel Dissolve
items.description: A grid of square cells blinks on in a diagonal, slightly scattered order, flashing the accent before going solid. The views swap behind the grid and the cells drop away in a second wave.

items.name: transition-shared-morph
items.title: Transition Shared Morph
items.description: Elements that carry the same data-morph name in both views fly from their old box to their new one while the rest of the views crossfade. Good for a list row that opens into a detail card.

items.name: transition-curtain-call
items.title: Transition Curtain Call
items.description: Pleated stage drapes swing shut from both wings with a lagging hem, a valance drops and a warm spot hits the closed curtain. The scene changes behind it and the drapes part again.

items.name: transition-ripple-reveal
items.title: Transition Ripple Reveal
items.description: Click anywhere and the other view spreads out as a circle from that exact point, chased by two thin rings. Built for theme switches and before and after toggles.

items.name: transition-page-turn
items.title: Transition Page Turn
items.description: The right half of the view lifts at the spine and turns over like a magazine page, with the next view printed on its back. Shading follows the angle of the page as it travels.

items.name: transition-zoom-through
items.title: Transition Zoom Through
items.description: The camera dives into a focal point: the first view rushes past and blurs out while the second grows into place from deep behind, with light streaks for speed. Switching back zooms out the same way.

items.name: transition-split-flap
items.title: Transition Split Flap
items.description: The view is cut into flaps hinged at the middle, like a station board. Each column drops its top half in turn, left to right, and settles with a small bounce.

items.name: transition-liquid-wipe
items.title: Transition Liquid Wipe
items.description: A wavy liquid front with a bulging belly pours across the frame, led by a colored rim that moves out of step with it. Reversing drains it back the way it came.

items.name: transition-glitch-cut
items.title: Transition Glitch Cut
items.description: A hard digital cut: slices of the new view tear in over the old one with jitter, skew and a split color fringe, while scan bars flash across. Over in about half a second.

items.name: transition-parallax-slide
items.title: Transition Parallax Slide
items.description: A push navigation: the new view slides over the old one, which drifts back and darkens under it. Children marked data-depth 1 to 3 inside either view travel at their own speed for depth.

items.name: loader-orbit-sync
items.title: Loader Orbit Sync
items.description: Satellites travel tilted elliptical orbits around a sync hub, growing as they pass in front and fading behind it. The hub sends out a pulse each time a satellite comes around.

items.name: loader-file-morph
items.title: Loader File Morph
items.description: A single shape morphs between a document, an image frame, an audio disc and a code hexagon, with the inner glyph crossfading at each step. Built for exports and format conversions.

items.name: loader-skeleton-feed
items.title: Loader Skeleton Feed
items.description: Content-shaped placeholders for a post feed, an inbox or a card grid, with one diagonal shimmer that travels across every bone in order. When loading ends, the real children fade in from a soft blur.

items.name: loader-liquid-progress
items.title: Loader Liquid Progress
items.description: A progress pill filled with liquid: the leading edge sloshes as a live wave and bubbles rise inside. The percentage changes color exactly where the liquid passes under it.

items.name: loader-tick-ring
items.title: Loader Tick Ring
items.description: A dial of fine ticks lights up clockwise with a brighter, longer leading tick, and phase markers around the rim switch on as each stage is reached. The center shows the percentage and the current phase.

items.name: loader-dot-field
items.title: Loader Dot Field
items.description: A grid of dots breathes in a ripple, a traveling wave or a diagonal sweep, each dot swelling and glowing as the crest passes. Reads like a voice or audio engine at work.

items.name: loader-status-feed
items.title: Loader Status Feed
items.description: Status lines are typed out one at a time with a block caret and a spinner, then checked off with a timing as the next line scrolls in. Good for long jobs that should show what they are doing.

items.name: loader-gauge-counter
items.title: Loader Gauge Counter
items.description: A segmented 240 degree gauge fills with a color ramp and a glowing tip while an odometer of rolling digits counts up in the center. Leading zeros stay dimmed like an instrument panel.

items.name: loader-stack-build
items.title: Loader Stack Build
items.description: Isometric slabs drop one by one onto a stack, landing with a small squash, while a dashed outline marks where the next one goes. When the stack is complete it lifts away and the build starts over.

items.name: loader-device-scan
items.title: Loader Device Scan
items.description: A half-dial sonar sweeps back and forth with a fading wake, and nearby devices light up the moment the beam crosses them. A live count shows how many have been found.

items.name: loader-infinity-trace
items.title: Loader Infinity Trace
items.description: A bright head races around a figure eight, dragging a layered tail that fades and blurs behind it. Fits reconnecting and retrying states where the wait has no known end.

items.name: loader-button-progress
items.title: Loader Button Progress
items.description: A button that collapses into a thin progress bar on click, with the status and percentage riding above it. At 100 percent it grows back into a success pill and draws a check.

items.name: image-accordion-reel
items.title: Image Accordion Reel
items.description: Landscape panels that open one at a time on a story-style timer, with segmented progress at the top. The ridges of each scene slide into place as its panel widens, and hovering pauses the reel.

items.name: image-accordion-vertical
items.title: Image Accordion Vertical
items.description: Stacked bands that open like an aperture: the image stays fixed while the band grows from its center, so more of the scene is revealed rather than scaled. Each open band shows a description and a project link.

items.name: image-accordion-stagger
items.title: Image Accordion Stagger
items.description: Product panels set at staggered heights with titles running up their edges. The open panel levels out, its title swings from vertical to horizontal on a spring and the product rises into view.

items.name: parallax-depth-cards
items.title: Parallax Depth Cards
items.description: A headline surrounded by floating interface cards on several depth planes. As you scroll, near cards travel further and stay sharp while far cards drift slowly, blurred and dimmed.

items.name: parallax-sticky-captions
items.title: Parallax Sticky Captions
items.description: A pinned exploded view beside captions that scroll past. The view pans and zooms to the part each caption describes and lights it up, with a progress rail tracking the walkthrough.

items.name: parallax-floating-gallery
items.title: Parallax Floating Gallery
items.description: A tilted wall of photographs in columns that drift in opposite directions at different speeds as you scroll, around a pinned title and call to action. Tiles lift and show their caption on hover.

items.name: prompt-box-modes
items.title: Prompt Box Modes
items.description: A composer with file attachments, Search, Think and Create mode chips that retint the box, and a send button that morphs into a Stop pill while a response is running. Enter sends, Escape stops.

items.name: prompt-voice-recorder
items.title: Prompt Voice Recorder
items.description: A composer that turns into a live waveform with a timer while you dictate, then collapses into a transcribing state and types the transcript into the box. It can read a real microphone level or simulate speech.

items.name: prompt-slash-commands
items.title: Prompt Slash Commands
items.description: A composer where / opens commands and @ opens context sources, with an inline ghost completion that Tab accepts. Picks become removable tokens in front of the text, and Backspace at the start removes the last one.

items.name: card-foil-pass
items.title: Card Foil Pass
items.description: An event pass with a holographic foil pattern, a rainbow seal and engraved lines that catch the light as the card tilts toward the pointer. Click or press Enter to flip it to a scannable back.

items.name: card-hand-fan
items.title: Card Hand Fan
items.description: A loose pile of cards that fans into an arc like a hand of playing cards. Hovered cards rise and push their neighbors aside, and picking one lifts it to the front while the rest fold back.

items.name: card-flip-deck
items.title: Card Flip Deck
items.description: A rolodex of city cards where the front card flips over its top edge to reveal the next. Flip with a click, the wheel, a vertical drag, arrow keys or on a timer.

items.name: bg-ferrofluid
items.title: Ferrofluid
items.description: A dark, glossy liquid-metal pool whose blobs rise toward the pointer and grow a crown of magnetic spikes, shaded with specular highlights.

items.name: bg-soft-aurora
items.title: Soft Aurora
items.description: Wide pastel aurora curtains that drift slowly, with a gentle bloom that follows the pointer and tiny motes floating upward.

items.name: bg-rune-rings
items.title: Rune Rings
items.description: Concentric glowing rings carrying orbiting glyph marks, each ring spinning at its own speed. The pointer tilts the whole system in 3D.

items.name: bg-grid-scan
items.title: Grid Scan
items.description: A flat grid crossed by a horizontal and a vertical scan line. The cell under the pointer lights up and leaves a trail of fading cells.

items.name: bg-color-bends
items.title: Color Bends
items.description: Saturated ribbons of color that flow across the area, twisting as they go and bending around a warp field that follows the pointer.

items.name: bg-prism-burst
items.title: Prism Burst
items.description: A slowly rotating burst of light rays that split into spectrum colors from a bright core that follows the pointer.

items.name: bg-faulty-terminal
items.title: Faulty Terminal
items.description: A wall of scrolling terminal output that tears, glitches and flickers now and then. Glyphs near the pointer brighten and scramble.

items.name: gallery-infinite-spiral
items.title: Gallery Infinite Spiral
items.description: Images laid out along a spiral that drifts forever, growing and brightening as they leave the center. Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys to move along it.

items.name: carousel-depth
items.title: Carousel Depth
items.description: A carousel in perspective: the active card is large and sharp while its neighbors turn away, shrink and dim. Supports drag, arrows, dots, keyboard and autoplay that pauses on hover.

items.name: wheel-option-picker
items.title: Wheel Option Picker
items.description: A vertical drum picker. Options sit on a cylinder in perspective and snap to the center after a drag, flick, wheel step or key press. Set the text size with style or className on the picker.

items.name: menu-staggered
items.title: Menu Staggered
items.description: A full-frame menu that slides in as three layered panels, then reveals its links one by one. The hamburger morphs into a close icon, Escape closes it and focus stays inside.

items.name: nav-card-expand
items.title: Nav Card Expand
items.description: A compact top bar that unfolds downward into a card with three link cards and a call to action. The panel floats over the page, so nothing below it moves.

items.name: bg-wave-pattern
items.title: Wave Pattern
items.description: A tiled pattern of stripes, checks or diamonds warped by travelling sine waves. Cells near the pointer lean toward it and pick up the accent color.

items.name: bg-slats
items.title: Slats
items.description: Rows of thin vertical slats that turn and catch the light in a rolling wave. A bright crest follows the pointer across them.

items.name: bg-ghost-fibers
items.title: Ghost Fibers
items.description: Translucent strands that drift on smooth noise and leave faint trails behind them. Strands thicken and glow where the pointer passes.

items.name: bg-crt-warp
items.title: CRT Warp
items.description: An old tube screen: curved frame, scanlines, color fringing, flicker and a rolling bar. The pointer pushes a lens of distortion across the glass. Shows an animated test pattern when it has no children.

items.name: bg-acid-squares
items.title: Acid Squares
items.description: A grid of squares that flash neon colors in rings spreading out from the pointer. Pulses fire on their own while nobody is touching it, and a click sends a bigger wave.

items.name: bg-scanner-sweep
items.title: Scanner Sweep
items.description: A beam sweeps back and forth over a grid of dots, lighting cells as it passes and marking a few as detected. The pointer takes hold of the beam.

items.name: bg-web-threads
items.title: Web Threads
items.description: A spider web strung to the edges with a knot in the middle. Moving the pointer across a thread plucks it, and the vibration travels through the web before it settles.

items.name: ball-crystal
items.title: Crystal Ball
items.description: A faceted low-poly sphere drawn on canvas. It turns slowly, tilts toward the pointer and moves its highlights with it.

items.name: edge-gradual-blur
items.title: Edge Gradual Blur
items.description: An overlay for the edge of a container that blurs the content under it a little more with every pixel, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers.

items.name: logo-loop-belt
items.title: Logo Loop Belt
items.description: An endless belt of wordmark chips with faded edges. It slows down or stops on hover and can run a second row in the opposite direction.

items.name: border-star-orbit
items.title: Border Star Orbit
items.description: A card whose border carries a glowing four-point star that circles the perimeter, dragging a trail of fading color behind it.

items.name: radio-jelly
items.title: Jelly Radio
items.description: A radio group whose selected dot squashes and stretches like jelly when it is chosen, while the label slides over. Arrow keys work out of the box.

items.name: checkbox-spring
items.title: Spring Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose box springs past its size when checked while the tick draws itself and bounces in. Supports a label and an indeterminate state.

items.name: micro-status-mark
items.title: Status Mark
items.description: A small status indicator whose outline morphs between a circle, a triangle and a rounded square as it changes between idle, loading, success, warning and error.

items.name: tooltip-warm
items.title: Warm Tooltip
items.description: A cream tooltip with a soft amber glow that springs out of its trigger with a small arrow wobble. Opens after a delay on hover and at once on keyboard focus.

items.name: menu-branched
items.title: Branched Menu
items.description: A tree menu whose submenus branch out with connector lines that draw in one after another. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape work at every level.

items.name: micro-code-slots
items.title: Code Slots
items.description: A code or PIN display where every character is a vertical reel that spins and settles on its value, with a short glow when each reel locks. Changing the value replays it.

items.name: select-glide
items.title: Glide Select
items.description: A custom select whose highlight glides between options on a spring and whose arrow rotates open. Supports arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Escape and type-ahead.

items.name: micro-slide-commit
items.title: Slide Commit
items.description: A press-and-slide control for destructive actions. The track turns from neutral to danger as the handle moves and locks with a pop when it reaches the end. Hold Enter does the same from the keyboard.

items.name: text-tech-readout
items.title: Tech Readout
items.description: Text that appears like an instrument readout: letters flip through glyphs before settling, corner brackets and a tick scale draw in, and small mono labels fade up around it.

items.name: text-echo
items.title: Text Echo
items.description: Text with trailing echo copies that stagger in, fade out with distance and breathe slowly. Hover or focus spreads them apart.

items.name: text-depth-layers
items.title: Depth Layers
items.description: Text built from many stacked layers that shift with the pointer for real parallax depth, with a shadow stack for volume. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: text-fold
items.title: Text Fold
items.description: Lines of text that fold open like paper with a per-line rotateX and perspective when they scroll into view, then pleat into an accordion on hover and unfold again when you leave.

items.name: button-specular
items.title: Specular Button
items.description: A metallic, glass or blue button with a specular highlight that slides across its surface, a lit edge bevel and a subtle tilt that follow the pointer. A scripted highlight plays until the pointer arrives.

items.name: card-border-glow
items.title: Card Border Glow
items.description: A card whose border lights up in the segment nearest the pointer, with a soft bloom spilling both outside and inside. While idle the glow slowly circles the border.

items.name: bento-pointer-glow
items.title: Bento Pointer Glow
items.description: A three-column bento grid where one cursor-following glow lights every tile border and surface. Tiles lift on hover or focus and swap their description for a secondary caption; built-in visuals animate on their own.

items.name: nav-gooey
items.title: Gooey Nav
items.description: A pill navigation whose active indicator is a gooey blob. Three blobs with different timings stretch and merge through an SVG filter as the selection moves. Arrow keys, Home and End change the selection.

items.name: slider-elastic
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider whose track bends toward the pointer like a rubber band while you drag and springs back on release. The thumb rides the curve with a value bubble above it. Arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End also work.

items.name: bg-galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A tilted spiral galaxy of thousands of twinkling stars with a warm core and dark dust lanes, turning slowly. The pointer shifts the depth layers and parts the stars around it.

items.name: bg-dark-veil
items.title: Dark Veil
items.description: A dark translucent veil of drifting smoke with faint colored light at its edges. The pointer lifts a ragged, glowing tear in it that stretches as it moves.

items.name: bg-silk-threads
items.title: Silk Threads
items.description: Dozens of long, thin threads flowing across the area in offset waves, with a highlight that slides along each one. The pointer combs through them and pushes them apart.

items.name: bg-layered-waves
items.title: Layered Waves
items.description: Stacked translucent waves in depth with gradient fills and soft crest lines, rolling gently. The wave closest to the pointer rises toward it.

items.name: bg-grid-motion
items.title: Grid Motion
items.description: A tilted wall of gradient tiles with small charts and cards, its rows sliding in alternating directions. Rows under the pointer speed up and brighten.

items.name: text-shuffle-in
items.title: Text Shuffle In
items.description: Every letter slides through a few other letters before it lands on its own. Plays when the text enters the viewport and again on hover or focus.

items.name: text-scroll-float
items.title: Text Scroll Float
items.description: Lines of text whose letters float up into place in a wave as the element scrolls into view. Progress follows the scroll position.

items.name: text-scroll-words
items.title: Text Scroll Words
items.description: A paragraph that wakes up word by word, from dim and blurred to bright and sharp, as it scrolls through the viewport.

items.name: text-circular
items.title: Text Circular
items.description: Text set around a circle that turns slowly. Hovering speeds it up and spins it the other way. The center takes any content.

items.name: text-ascii-render
items.title: Text ASCII Render
items.description: Turns text into a field of monospace characters on a canvas. The letters ripple on their own and light up around the pointer.

items.name: micro-sling-button
items.title: Sling Button
items.description: Drag the button back against a stretching band and let go. It slings forward, overshoots and settles on a spring.

items.name: micro-dodge-field
items.title: Dodge Field
items.description: A text field with a glowing dot that slips away from the pointer on a spring and tucks into the corner on focus. The input underneath is a plain accessible input.

items.name: micro-swipe-toast
items.title: Swipe Toast
items.description: A toast you flick sideways to dismiss. It resists with a rubber band, flies off past a threshold and carries an undo chip. Escape and the arrow keys dismiss it too.

items.name: micro-swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: A list row that reveals Archive on a swipe right and Delete on a swipe left. It snaps open or closed with momentum, and the arrow keys reveal the same actions.

items.name: micro-squish-switch
items.title: Squish Switch
items.description: A switch whose knob behaves like jelly. It squashes under the press, stretches in the direction of travel and wobbles into place, and it also follows a drag or a flick.

items.name: micro-wake-slider
items.title: Wake Slider
items.description: A slider whose thumb drags a stretching wake of liquid behind it and sends out ripples where it comes to rest. Arrow keys, Home, End and Page keys all work.

items.name: micro-rubber-segment
items.title: Rubber Segment
items.description: A segmented control whose selection pill stretches like rubber toward the new option, leading with one edge and letting the other catch up. Dragging across segments works too.

items.name: micro-pulse-heart
items.title: Pulse Heart
items.description: A heart toggle that beats twice in a loop while hovered or focused and fills with a burst of rings and sparks when pressed.

items.name: micro-bell-toggle
items.title: Bell Toggle
items.description: A notifications bell that swings on a decaying spring with a lagging clapper. Turning it on rings it and pops a badge dot; turning it off settles it quietly.

items.name: micro-comet-dial
items.title: Comet Dial
items.description: A rotary dial you flick. It spins with inertia, clicks into detents while the readout snaps to each one, and a comet tail follows the pointer around the rim.

items.name: checkout-one-page
items.title: Checkout One Page
items.description: Contact, shipping, delivery and payment on a single page beside a sticky order summary. Card numbers format as you type and pass a Luhn check, a progress rail fills as each part becomes valid, and a success state replaces the form.

items.name: checkout-split-summary
items.title: Checkout Split Summary
items.description: A dark two-column checkout with a brand panel on the left holding the order, a promotion code field and trust badges, and a card form on the right. The total counts to its new value when a code is applied.

items.name: checkout-stepper-card
items.title: Checkout Stepper Card
items.description: One centered card that walks through Details, Payment and Confirm with a glowing progress track. Steps slide in from the direction you travel, each step validates before moving on, and the review step links back to edit.

items.name: checkout-mobile-sheet
items.title: Checkout Mobile Sheet
items.description: A phone mockup with a product page and a wallet-style payment sheet that rises from the bottom. Payment is confirmed by dragging a slider, or with the arrow keys and Enter, followed by a success state inside the sheet.

items.name: checkout-subscription-upgrade
items.title: Checkout Subscription Upgrade
items.description: A light plan upgrade screen comparing the current plan with the new one. A seat slider drives a proration breakdown whose figures count to their new values, next to the card on file and a confirm button.

items.name: checkout-success-receipt
items.title: Checkout Success Receipt
items.description: An order confirmation with a self-drawing success mark, a paper receipt that prints out of a slot with perforated edges and a barcode, and a delivery timeline. Download receipt saves a text file locally unless you handle it.

items.name: checkout-payment-failed
items.title: Checkout Payment Failed
items.description: A declined payment screen that explains the reason and offers three ways forward: retry the same card, enter another card, or pay by bank transfer with copyable sample details. A support card sits alongside with the order reference.

items.name: checkout-billing-settings
items.title: Checkout Billing Settings
items.description: A light billing settings page with the current plan, saved payment methods that can be made default or removed after an inline confirm, billing email and tax ID fields with format checks, usage meters and the next invoice.

items.name: checkout-invoice-history
items.title: Checkout Invoice History
items.description: Invoice history with counting totals, an upcoming invoice card, status filters, search and a year select over a table with status pills and download buttons. The table turns into stacked rows in narrow containers and exports to CSV locally.

items.name: checkout-pricing-modal
items.title: Checkout Pricing Modal
items.description: Plan cards inside a dialog over a dimmed app, with a monthly and yearly switch, prices that roll on change and a summary bar with Continue. Focus is trapped while open, Escape and the backdrop close it, and focus returns to the Upgrade button.

items.name: like-heart-fill
items.title: Like Heart Fill
items.description: A heart button that fills with a rolling liquid wave, pulses two rings and rolls its count to the new value.

items.name: like-thumbs-pop
items.title: Like Thumbs Pop
items.description: A thumbs-up that tilts back, pops forward and throws a fan of spark lines, with a rolling like count beside it.

items.name: like-reaction-picker
items.title: Like Reaction Picker
items.description: A react button that opens a row of five face reactions on click or press and hold. The hovered face scales up and the choice replaces the button label.

items.name: like-star-favorite
items.title: Like Star Favorite
items.description: A star toggle that spins, sprays a burst of tiny stars and shows an Added to favorites chip that fades on its own.

items.name: like-bookmark
items.title: Like Bookmark
items.description: A bookmark ribbon that drops into a tray with a bounce and a squash, next to a rolling saved counter.

items.name: follow-button
items.title: Follow Button
items.description: A pill that morphs its width between Follow, Following and Unfollow on hover, with a check that draws itself.

items.name: vote-arrows
items.title: Vote Arrows
items.description: An up and down vote pair with a rolling score, one active vote at a time and optimistic updates that roll back when onVote rejects.

items.name: share-popover
items.title: Share Popover
items.description: A share button that opens an anchored popover with a link field, a copy button that confirms and four generic channels. Escape and outside click close it.

items.name: share-sheet
items.title: Share Sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet with a scrim, a drag handle, a channel grid and a copy link row. It lives in its own frame, closes on drag down, scrim click or Escape.

items.name: share-floating-rail
items.title: Share Floating Rail
items.description: A round share trigger that fans a vertical rail of icon buttons out with a staggered spring. Each button shows a tooltip on hover or focus.

items.name: pay-card-preview
items.title: Pay Card Preview
items.description: A payment card that shows live number, name and expiry, and flips in 3D to the back when the CVC field is focused.

items.name: pay-card-form
items.title: Pay Card Form
items.description: A card entry form with grouped number formatting, a Luhn check, brand detection, expiry validation and a live card preview. It never sends data anywhere.

items.name: pay-method-picker
items.title: Pay Method Picker
items.description: A radio list of payment methods with a highlight that slides to the selection and a detail panel that expands under it.

items.name: pay-success-check
items.title: Pay Success Check
items.description: A payment success state where a ring draws, a check strokes in, dots burst outward and the amount and reference fade up.

items.name: pay-failed-retry
items.title: Pay Failed Retry
items.description: A payment failure state with a shaking x mark, an error message, reason chips and Retry and Change method buttons.

items.name: pay-slide-to-pay
items.title: Pay Slide To Pay
items.description: A slide to confirm control. The track fills as you drag, the handle turns into a check, and Enter or the arrow keys work too.

items.name: pay-order-summary
items.title: Pay Order Summary
items.description: Line items with quantity steppers, subtotal, discount, tax and total. Amounts roll when they change and the list folds on narrow containers.

items.name: pay-tip-selector
items.title: Pay Tip Selector
items.description: Tip percentage chips with the amount under each one, a custom amount field, and a total that rolls to the new value.

items.name: pay-coupon-field
items.title: Pay Coupon Field
items.description: A coupon input with Apply, loading, valid and invalid states. A valid code turns into a removable chip with the saving; an invalid one shakes.

items.name: pay-subscription-toggle
items.title: Pay Subscription Toggle
items.description: A plan card with a monthly and yearly switch. A pill slides between the two, the price rolls to the new figure and a savings badge pops in.

items.name: pay-invoice-card
items.title: Pay Invoice Card
items.description: An invoice summary with a Paid, Due or Overdue status pill, line items, download and pay buttons, and a perforated bottom edge.

items.name: pay-wallet-balance
items.title: Pay Wallet Balance
items.description: A wallet card with a counting balance, quick top-up amounts, recent activity and an eye button that blurs the figures.

items.name: login-glass-card
items.title: Login Glass Card
items.description: A frosted sign-in card floating over a slowly drifting mesh gradient and glassy orbs, with provider buttons, email and password fields, validation and a success state.

items.name: login-passkey
items.title: Login Passkey
items.description: A passkey-first sign-in with a large fingerprint that traces its ridges while a scan line sweeps, a Use passkey button with waiting and success states, and a password form that expands smoothly as a fallback.

items.name: login-social-first
items.title: Login Social First
items.description: A light sign-in page that leads with a grid of provider buttons with generic glyphs and a Last used badge, then an email and password form below a divider.

items.name: login-minimal-line
items.title: Login Minimal Line
items.description: An ultra-minimal sign-in on warm paper: a large serif greeting whose words rise in, underline fields with floating labels that draw an ink line on focus, and a pill submit button.

items.name: login-forgot-password
items.title: Login Forgot Password
items.description: A forgot password card with an animated envelope: enter an email, and it opens to show the letter, masks the address and starts a resend countdown.

items.name: login-reset-password
items.title: Login Reset Password
items.description: A new password form with a four-segment strength meter, a rules checklist that ticks off as you type, a time-to-crack estimate, confirmation matching and a success state.

items.name: login-two-factor-choice
items.title: Login Two-Factor Choice
items.description: A two-step verification screen with method radio cards for authenticator app, text message and security key, a step tracker, and a second step that shows the matching code input or key prompt.

items.name: login-account-chooser
items.title: Login Account Chooser
items.description: A choose-an-account screen with gradient avatars, workspace badges and signed-in dots, full arrow key navigation, a remembered device chip, a Use another account row and a remove mode.

items.name: login-terminal
items.title: Login Terminal
items.description: A developer sign-in told as a terminal session: prompt lines type in, a one-time device code appears with a copy button, a pulsing waiting line counts down to expiry, plus a token form for headless machines.

items.name: login-onboarding-profile
items.title: Login Onboarding Profile
items.description: A first-run profile setup in three steps with a progress bar: gradient avatar picker and name, a role chip, interest chips with a minimum, a live profile preview and a confetti finish.

items.name: card-glare
items.title: Card Glare
items.description: A poster card that tilts slightly toward the pointer while a specular band and a lit edge slide across its surface.

items.name: card-profile-holo
items.title: Profile Holo
items.description: A profile card with a foil layer whose rainbow shifts with the pointer angle, an initials avatar and a stats row.

items.name: card-pixel-hover
items.title: Pixel Hover
items.description: A canvas card whose picture breaks into a grid of pixels in a wave that starts where the pointer enters, then reforms on leave.

items.name: card-decay
items.title: Card Decay
items.description: A card whose image follows the pointer on a spring and swings with its speed, while a large title and an outlined echo trail behind it.

items.name: card-sticker-peel
items.title: Sticker Peel
items.description: A die-cut sticker on its backing sheet. Drag to peel a corner and reveal the backing, click or press Enter to peel or reset.

items.name: card-bounce-stack
items.title: Bounce Stack
items.description: A tight pile of rotated cards that fans out with an overshooting bounce on hover or focus and settles back on leave.

items.name: card-chroma-grid
items.title: Chroma Grid
items.description: A grid of cards that stays grayscale except under a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, where each card lights up in its own accent.

items.name: gallery-accordion
items.title: Gallery Accordion
items.description: A row of image panels where the hovered or focused one grows wide and the rest fold into slim strips with vertical labels.

items.name: gallery-drift-wall
items.title: Drift Wall
items.description: A wall of tiles in columns that drift against the pointer at different depths, with the hovered tile lifting forward.

items.name: card-stack-drag
items.title: Stack Drag
items.description: A deck of cards where you drag or flick the top card away with momentum and it drops to the back. Arrow keys cycle too.

items.name: scroll-progress-bar
items.title: Scroll Progress Bar
items.description: A thin gradient bar pinned to the top of the page or a container, with a percentage chip that rides its head.

items.name: scroll-parallax-layers
items.title: Scroll Parallax Layers
items.description: A dusk scene built from three SVG layers (sky, hills, pines) that drift at different speeds as it crosses the viewport.

items.name: scroll-pin-steps
items.title: Scroll Pin Steps
items.description: A pinned stage that swaps its content step by step as you scroll, with clickable step dots and a progress line.

items.name: scroll-stagger-grid
items.title: Scroll Stagger Grid
items.description: A grid of tiles that fly in one after another from alternating directions as it scrolls into view, and fly back out in reverse.

items.name: scroll-zoom-reveal
items.title: Scroll Zoom Reveal
items.description: A small framed image that grows to fill the whole stage while the headline fades away. A caption fades in at the end.

items.name: scroll-horizontal-track
items.title: Scroll Horizontal Track
items.description: A pinned section where vertical scrolling slides a strip of cards sideways, with a progress rail and a card counter.

items.name: scroll-counter-ticker
items.title: Scroll Counter Ticker
items.description: A pinned section with a big odometer whose value is tied to scroll progress. Digits roll vertically and carry over like a real counter.

items.name: scroll-sticky-stack
items.title: Scroll Sticky Stack
items.description: Cards that stick to the top and pile on each other. Each card shrinks and dims a little as the next one slides over it.

items.name: image-wipe-slider
items.title: Image Wipe Slider
items.description: A slideshow where each photo takes over with a diagonal, soft-edged wipe. Includes arrows, dots, auto-advance and keyboard control.

items.name: image-mosaic-reveal
items.title: Image Mosaic Reveal
items.description: The next photo appears tile by tile in a fixed shuffled order, each tile popping in over the previous image.

items.name: image-liquid-distort
items.title: Image Liquid Distort
items.description: A photo that ripples like water through an SVG turbulence filter. The warp swells on hover and focus and spikes when the slide changes.

items.name: image-pixelate-transition
items.title: Image Pixelate Transition
items.description: A canvas transition that pixelates the current photo into coarse blocks, swaps to the next at the peak and resolves it back to sharp.

items.name: image-split-slide
items.title: Image Split Slide
items.description: The current photo splits down the middle and the two halves slide apart to uncover the next one, which settles in from a slight zoom.

items.name: image-parallax-tilt
items.title: Image Parallax Tilt
items.description: A photo that tilts in 3D toward the pointer while its background, middle and foreground layers drift at different depths, with a moving glare. It sways on its own until touched.

items.name: image-ken-burns
items.title: Image Ken Burns
items.description: A story-style slideshow with slow zoom and pan on every photo, crossfades, segmented progress bars and tap zones for previous and next.

items.name: image-gallery-expand
items.title: Image Gallery Expand
items.description: A row of narrow image strips where the hovered or focused strip widens to reveal its caption. Click or press Enter to select one.

items.name: image-stack-swipe
items.title: Image Stack Swipe
items.description: A stack of photo cards. Drag the top one away with a tilt, or use the arrow keys, to reveal the next card underneath.

items.name: image-hover-zoom-lens
items.title: Image Hover Zoom Lens
items.description: A round magnifier that follows the pointer and shows the photo enlarged. It drifts along its own path until the pointer arrives and can be moved with the arrow keys.

items.name: toggle-theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: A sun and moon switch. The thumb morphs between a rayed sun and a crescent while clouds drift out and stars twinkle in.

items.name: toggle-gooey
items.title: Gooey Toggle
items.description: A pill toggle whose thumb stretches like liquid as it travels, built from two blobs merged by an SVG gooey filter.

items.name: checkbox-draw
items.title: Drawn Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that pops, fills and draws its check with a stroke. It also supports an indeterminate dash for select-all patterns.

items.name: radio-card-group
items.title: Radio Card Group
items.description: Selectable cards backed by native radios. A highlight slides to the chosen card and the radio dot springs in. Arrow keys move the selection.

items.name: input-floating-label
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: A text field whose label floats up on focus or when filled, with an animated focus line and error and success states.

items.name: input-password-strength
items.title: Password Strength Input
items.description: A password field with a show and hide button, a four segment strength bar and a checklist of rules that tick as they are met.

items.name: input-tags
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A tag field. Enter or comma adds a chip, Backspace removes the last one, and chips scale in and out. Supports a maximum count.

items.name: slider-range-dual
items.title: Dual Range Slider
items.description: A two thumb range slider with a filled track, value bubbles, a minimum gap, pointer dragging and full keyboard control.

items.name: stepper-number
items.title: Number Stepper
items.description: A quantity stepper with plus and minus buttons, digits that roll like an odometer and hold to repeat with acceleration.

items.name: select-command
items.title: Command Select
items.description: A searchable select. Type to filter with highlighted matches, move with the arrow keys, group options and close with Escape.

items.name: otp-input-inline
items.title: Inline Code Input
items.description: A compact one line code field built on a single real input, with a blinking caret, pop-in characters and full paste support.

items.name: cursor-target
items.title: Cursor Target
items.description: A lock-on reticle with four corner brackets and a rotating dashed ring. It follows the pointer and shrinks onto buttons and links when you hover or tab to them.

items.name: cursor-ghost
items.title: Cursor Ghost
items.description: A faint ghost that trails the pointer on a spring, leans into its motion, looks where it is going and leaves a fading afterimage.

items.name: cursor-swarm
items.title: Cursor Swarm
items.description: A flock of small arrow points that steer toward the pointer, keep their distance from each other and circle it like starlings.

items.name: cursor-fluid-splash
items.title: Cursor Fluid Splash
items.description: Colorful blobs pour out along the pointer path, carry its velocity, swirl in a soft flow field and fade into streaks.

items.name: cursor-ribbons
items.title: Cursor Ribbons
items.description: Several glowing ribbons chase the pointer through spring-chained segments, taper to a point and blend where they cross.

items.name: cursor-metaballs
items.title: Cursor Metaballs
items.description: A gooey blob follows the pointer while smaller blobs orbit it, stretch away and melt back in through an SVG goo filter.

items.name: cursor-pixel-trail
items.title: Cursor Pixel Trail
items.description: Cells on a pixel grid light up under the pointer and fade out in hard steps, like an old LED matrix.

items.name: cursor-image-trail
items.title: Cursor Image Trail
items.description: Small photo tiles drop along the pointer path every few dozen pixels, then tilt, drift away and fade.

items.name: cursor-crosshair
items.title: Cursor Crosshair
items.description: Full-width dashed guide lines follow the pointer with X and Y readout chips and a dot that snaps to a grid, like a design tool ruler.

items.name: cursor-glare-grid
items.title: Cursor Glare Grid
items.description: A field of tiny needles turns to face the pointer like compasses, growing and lighting up the closer they are.

items.name: text-pressure
items.title: Text Pressure
items.description: Every letter swells in weight and size as the pointer gets close, with a slow breathing wave when nothing is touching it.

items.name: text-scramble-hover
items.title: Text Scramble Hover
items.description: Letters near the pointer flip to random glyphs and settle back one by one once it moves away.

items.name: text-warp
items.title: Text Warp
items.description: A lens follows the pointer and bends the line: letters shove aside, grow and tilt with a smooth falloff.

items.name: text-fuzzy
items.title: Text Fuzzy
items.description: Text with a flickering noise displacement, like a worn signal, that grows rougher while hovered or focused.

items.name: text-mask-reveal
items.title: Text Mask Reveal
items.description: Lines or words slide up out of an invisible mask with a stagger when the block scrolls into view.

items.name: text-highlight-marker
items.title: Text Highlight Marker
items.description: Chosen words get a hand-drawn marker stroke that sweeps across them one after another.

items.name: text-underline-draw
items.title: Text Underline Draw
items.description: A wavy or straight underline that draws itself under the text on hover, focus or when it scrolls into view.

items.name: text-odometer
items.title: Text Odometer
items.description: Each digit rolls vertically to its new value like a mechanical counter, with separators and symbols left in place.

items.name: text-flip-words
items.title: Text Flip Words
items.description: A sentence with one slot that flips through a list of words in 3D while the line resizes to fit each one.

items.name: text-fill-scroll
items.title: Text Fill Scroll
items.description: A paragraph that fills with color word by word, left to right, as it scrolls through the viewport.

items.name: text-3d-extrude
items.title: Text 3D Extrude
items.description: Text built from a stack of shifted layers that forms a solid extrusion and tilts with the pointer.

items.name: text-liquid-gradient
items.title: Text Liquid Gradient
items.description: Text filled with soft color blobs that drift through each other, over a blurred glow of the same colors.

items.name: bg-grid-distortion
items.title: Grid Distortion
items.description: A fine line grid that bulges around the pointer like a magnifying lens, with a soft accent glow where it bends. Drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: bg-magnet-lines
items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A field of short strokes that turn to face the pointer like iron filings around a magnet. Without a pointer they follow a slow swirl.

items.name: bg-dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A dense grid of dots that swell and scatter away from the pointer, then spring back into place with a little overshoot.

items.name: bg-ripple-water
items.title: Ripple Water
items.description: A dark water surface where the pointer leaves trails of wavy rings and a click drops a stone. Raindrops fall on their own while nobody is touching it.

items.name: bg-liquid-ether
items.title: Liquid Ether
items.description: Soft pastel clouds that drift on a slow current and get swept along by the speed and direction of the pointer, leaving a colored wake.

items.name: bg-topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: Contour lines of a slowly shifting terrain, like a living survey map. The pointer raises a hill that pulls the lines into rings around it.

items.name: bg-light-tunnel
items.title: Light Tunnel
items.description: Glowing rounded frames fly out of the distance in an endless tunnel. The vanishing point leans toward the pointer.

items.name: bg-glitch-letters
items.title: Glitch Letters
items.description: A wall of monospaced characters that keep flickering into new glyphs and colors, with short glitch bursts along a row. Letters brighten around the pointer.

items.name: button-spotlight
items.title: Button Spotlight
items.description: A soft light follows the pointer across the face while the border brightens near the cursor. It drifts on its own until the pointer arrives.

items.name: button-slide-fill
items.title: Button Slide Fill
items.description: Color fills from the side the pointer enters and drains out through the side it leaves, with the label color inverting in sync.

items.name: button-glitch-hover
items.title: Button Glitch Hover
items.description: Chromatic slices of the label jitter on hover and keyboard focus, then snap clean when the pointer leaves. A brief glitch also fires now and then while idle.

items.name: button-3d-press
items.title: Button 3D Press
items.description: A chunky tactile button with a solid depth edge. It squashes flat on press and springs back with overshoot.

items.name: button-neon-pulse
items.title: Button Neon Pulse
items.description: A neon outline with a breathing glow that quickens on hover. Each click sends a ring ripple out from the pointer.

items.name: button-arrow-reveal
items.title: Button Arrow Reveal
items.description: On hover the label slides left while an arrow slides in beside it. Clicking loops the arrow out the right edge and back in.

items.name: button-stateful
items.title: Button Stateful
items.description: Morphs from idle to loading to success and back. The width animates to fit each label and the check draws itself. Driven by a promise returned from onClick or by a status prop.

items.name: button-copy
items.title: Button Copy
items.description: Copies a string to the clipboard. The icon morphs into a check and the label swaps from Copy to Copied, then reverts after 1.6 seconds.

items.name: button-download-progress
items.title: Button Download Progress
